Shared-task clusters default to disabled;standalone administrator controls still require complete evidence/explicit approval. 中文. Gap verification API/UI are integrated,with54 native contracts passing on each of PostgreSQL/MySQL;27 real-CDC checks pass with each PG/MySQL control store. See the operator guide for approval,cancellation and status semantics. Scope and consequences The initial scope is a MySQL source and transactional PostgreSQL/MySQL destinations. The next complete incremental transaction must have retained raw and normalized evidence. Only the synchronization service may write the destination. Schema, snapshot, ownership and dependency checks must pass. Cross-table transactions cannot be split. Snapshot, capture/decode, unknown transaction boundaries and other destination products are excluded. Repair the underlying fault first. Missing binlogs require restored logs, a qualified source or a new baseline;never change GTIDs to simulate success. A proven native APPLY commit requires acknowledgment reconciliation, not skipping. Skipping performs no business DML for that transaction. It records a native SKIPPED receipt and a durable gap for the selected subscriber, then advances only that subscriber acknowledgment. Source logs and other subscriber ACKs are unchanged. Later updates may fail because of missing rows, keyless identities or business dependencies. Continuing replication does not establish data equality. UI workflow 1. Pause the whole task and wait for destination fencing. A paused subscriber alone is insufficient. 2. Retain fresh transaction evidence for the failed destination;review the complete raw/normalized events, source position and scope. Historical observations do not authorize execution. 3. The observation must show CHECKPOINT NOT ADVANCED and TARGET APPLY, with current epoch, error generation and ACK. If no skip form appears, check capability, state and evidence;do not edit metadata to bypass guards. 4. An ADMIN enters an 8–1000-character reason, explicitly accepts the data gap and submits.202 means accepted;inspect the final operation result. 5. Both task and subscriber remain paused. Review the plan and gap, then explicitly resume only after checking subsequent transactions and recovery conditions. Open the original plan after a failed or timed-out operation. FAILED does not prove native absence:the plan may exist or the native skip may already have committed. Plan/native observation Allowed workflow --- --- PREPARED, no inspection Explicit read-only inspection;opening a window does not probe or mutate automatically PREPARED, COMMITTED Recover the committed gap acknowledgment;cannot cancel PREPARED, ABSENT Reapprove with a reason and explicit loss acceptance, or cancel with a reason PREPARED, UNKNOWN No continue, recover or cancel;resolve connectivity, metadata and backup consistency COMPLETED Historical receipt/gap;same-request same-parameter replay returns its result CANCELLED Historical cancellation;new approval requires fresh evidence/error generation Original approval, native execution and later source resolution retain their own actors and reasons. Cancellation requires proven native absence, does not advance ACK or repair the SQL fault, and invalidates the old error generation. Linux, Docker, Helm and manual Kubernetes upgrades Set the following consistently on every original controller and Agent, retaining all other global-control identities, roles, storage and keys: Use thefirst-release baselinefor Linux,Docker,Helm and manual Kubernetes. Control mode is fixed at creation;development-candidate automatic migration is unsupported. The first PREPARED plan atomically upgrades journal data format 3 to 4. The task configuration still uses formatVersion: 3 . The format3-to4 transition is part of the current journal lifecycle,not compatibility for old development programs. Pending plans block normal resume. Missing format 4 plan/gap tables are not recreated as empty history;restore the consistent recovery unit. Controlled native metadata migration adds a receipt table and two nullable checkpoint markers. MySQL implicit DDL commit does not release the source-journal fence. Appropriate metadata DDL privileges are required. Nontransactional tables and lost native receipts are not silently converted or rebuilt. API POST /api/tasks/ task /actions requires the current revision and X-Request-ID ;cookie writes retain CSRF/Origin requirements. Retry the same request with identical parameters. For SKIP RETRY , SKIP RECOVER or SKIP CANCEL , replace evidence references with planId and planHash . Retry requires acceptDataLoss: true ;recover/cancel explicitly require false . It must be a JSON boolean;strings, numbers, NULL and missing values are not approval. - GET /api/tasks/ task /recovery-plans/ planId :bounded metadata summary, no business-row reads. - POST .../recovery-plans/ planId /inspect with :point-in-time read-only native proof, no DDL/checkpoint advancement. - POST /api/tasks/ task /recovery-plans with "subscriptionId":"pg","after":"","limit":20 . - POST /api/tasks/ task /gaps with "subscriptionId":"pg","after":"0","limit":20 . All ledger reads are ADMIN-only. Pages permit at most 100 entries;use returned next cursors. Sequence/gap cursors are strings and must not be converted to JavaScript floating-point integers. Raw event values remain in separately authorized evidence pages. Oversized source positions are omitted as a whole with a hash;truncated GTIDs are never presented as usable resume positions. FAQ Native commit followed by Agent interruption or failed source ACK? Keep the original plan;PREPARED blocks ordinary resume. Restore the original Agent directory and inspect. Only COMMITTED permits acknowledgment recovery. A new unrelated skip request is not recovery. Force-cancel UNKNOWN? Unsupported. Already committed and absent operations require different actions;connectivity failure, missing metadata or inconsistent backups cannot establish either outcome. The original administrator was disabled? Execution rechecks current directory revision and ADMIN authority. Another authorized administrator can explicitly reapprove the original plan;original approver, native executor and source resolver remain separately recorded. Do GC or validation close gaps? No. Plans, receipts and gap history remain. Later normal APPLY may clear the current checkpoint marker but retains the gap. Complete verified gap closure is not yet implemented. Does RUNNING mean equality? No. Check hasGaps and the UI warning; gapCountLimited means a bounded count. Replication recovery and data equality are separate facts. Refusal codes? SKIP DISABLED :capability off. SKIP REQUIRES PIPELINE PAUSED :pause the whole task. SKIP RECOVERY PENDING :resolve the original plan. SKIP CHECKPOINT RECONCILIATION REQUIRED :inspect native APPLY first. SKIP NATIVE COMMIT NOT PROVEN :cannot recover. SKIP ALREADY COMMITTED :cannot cancel. SKIP NATIVE CHECKPOINT CHANGED / SKIP PLAN CHANGED :reload and verify the recovery unit.Invalid request fields return 400 REQUEST INVALID without accepting a command.

title: Validation records
text: Verification scope Current status · First-release baseline · SDD acceptance This entry points to the current baseline rather than repeating build/attempt histories. Separate versions/products/JDK scopes do not establish a complete compatibility matrix.

title: 恢复与一致性
text: 恢复、主库切换与一致性 本文描述 v2 单 database、单目标核心 ，不是 v3 快照和独立日志协议。English: V2 recovery。已实现的 v3 多库多目标、可选日志、Web 和消息恢复见 V3 手册 与消息手册。完整设计见 完整平台方案（English）。已确认的多库显式映射、同源多目标及独立恢复设计见 需求与决策（English）； 业务次级 UNIQUE/GSI 转普通索引及接管约束恢复见 Gauss 索引策略（English）。剩余适配器、修复和接管范围见实施状态。 同步服务主备 各进程首次启动幂等创建 v2 元数据；并发目录对象创建冲突单独处理，首个任务的配置和表清单原子插入。 工作前通过条件 UPDATE 获取 owner 和租约。独立心跳线程持续续期，数据/进度事务也校验同一 owner。 每次重新建立工作会话都生成新 owner，防止旧复制连接的回调在新会话中继续提交。 同一任务行的锁将采集、全量提交和增量应用的提交顺序串行化。 租约转移后，旧 owner 的业务事务在任何业务写入前就被拒绝；旧节点也不能替新 owner 暂停任务或释放租约。 节点只是备用时不会连接 binlog，同一任务正常只有一个复制客户端。 GTID 状态 - capture gtid：已经进入持久化队列或不影响业务库的已提交源事务，加上首次基线。 - required gtid：capture gtid 与全量扫描已读取状态所依赖的 GTID 的并集。 - applied sequence：已经写入目标业务表的队列事务序号。 源的物理 UUID 和文件位点只用于诊断、连接后端校验，不用于跨服务器恢复定位。 每个源提交事件先完整持久化，才把该事务 GTID 加入 capture gtid；不使用客户端可能提前更新的内存 GTID 直接覆盖状态。 重复 GTID 在持有任务锁时检查，已经持久化的事务不会重复加入队列。 全量期间也允许安全切主 记录基线 B0 后开始采集 FULL 行镜像，并按主键游标扫描业务表。 每次分块读取之后获取源 GTID 水位；分块数据、最后主键和该依赖水位一起提交到目标。 表发现和初始扫描上界读取的结束水位也保存为初始 required gtid。 若全量读取到了旧主库已提交、但采集器尚未持久化的事务，仅检查 capture gtid 会遗漏这一依赖。 因此切换候选必须包含 required gtid，不能只包含已采集事件。 所有分块完成后取结束 GTID B1，等待 capture gtid 覆盖 B1，再按源提交顺序回放队列。 对 B0 后没有变化的记录，扫描负责导入；有变化的记录，由最后一条完整行镜像或 DELETE 决定最终状态。 主键修改按删除旧键、写入新键处理，游标之前的插入及扫描上界之后的记录也由日志补齐。 全量和早期回放期间目标不是某一个时间点的一致性快照。持续增量阶段，每个源事务（包括跨表）在一个目标事务中应用。 主库发现与切换 1. 逐个检查候选地址，读取 UUID、server id、只读标记、GTID 模式、executed/purged 集合及复制状态。 2. 普通主从仅选择可写且没有活动上游线程或残留复制错误的节点。 3. Group Replication 仅选择 ONLINE、PRIMARY、可写、单主模式的节点。 4. 多个可写主库时等待外部高可用系统完成隔离，不能任选一个节点。 5. 要求 required gtid ⊆ candidate.gtid executed ；不满足则等待追平。 6. 要求 candidate.gtid purged ⊆ capture gtid ；不满足说明还有未采集的必要事务已无日志，任务暂停。 7. 新建复制连接使用持久化 GTID auto-positioning，禁用自动回退到 purged 集合。 JDBC 查询会校验物理 UUID 和可写性；复制连接在处理事件前校验握手查询到的 server id。 这也能发现 Router/VIP 在两种连接之间切换了后端，届时退出本次会话，重新发现而不混用数据。 心跳超时、源连接断开和源角色变化会触发新会话，重新读取持久化 GTID。 候选需要由运维保证全量复制、没有业务数据过滤或伪造 GTID，属于同一逻辑复制拓扑。 GTID 一致不等于能检测所有人工修改数据的情况。数据库自身丢失的异步未复制事务，不能由 CDC 重建。 提交边界 操作 一个目标事务内的内容 --- --- 创建任务 配置指纹、B0、表清单、扫描上界、发现水位 全量分块 业务行、游标、行数、完成状态、读取依赖 GTID 捕获源事务 有序完整行事件、来源、GTID、capture/required 集合 应用源事务 全部行修改、applied sequence、阶段变更、队列删除 记录故障 错误历史、共享 run state、最近错误上下文、释放 owner 提交响应不确定时退出本次会话，不复用旧内存游标或 GTID；新会话读取目标数据库的持久化记录。 数据表、队列和状态表必须作为同一个恢复单元备份和恢复。 SQL 错误与暂停 SQLState 08/40、锁等待和可恢复资源错误退避重试；数据、约束、权限和语法错误暂停。 错误记录保留表、源 GTID、队列事务序号、SQLState 和 vendor code，不记录行载荷或 SQL 字面量。 目标事务失败整体回滚，队列头不删除；采集端可能已把其他事务安全存入队列，这不会使应用越过错误。 PAUSED 是数据库中的共享状态，重启进程或新增备用节点不会绕过它。 修复数据类型、权限或约束后执行 resume，只重试原事务，不跳过、更改 GTID 或清空队列。 源复制 SQL 错误由数据库运维修复；服务不会自动执行 SQL SLAVE SKIP COUNTER、注入空 GTID 或 RESET。 正常主库可用时，故障从库不影响当前采集；故障从库被提升时会拒绝其接管，等待修复。 v1 文件位点任务缺少完整 GTID 和读取依赖，不能直接自动升级；新版本会保留旧状态并明确拒绝同名旧任务。

title: Acceptance matrix
text: SDD acceptance matrix RM-SDD-001 · 2026-11-17 These contracts track implementation acceptance. CP-01,SE-01/02/03/04/05,CP-07,RC-02 and RC-05 bounded profiles accepted; CP-05 is partial and remaining scope stays open. Given a supported profile/authorization,when normal,error or interrupted operations occur,the outcomes below must hold. Include positive,refusal,duplicate and relevant restart/failover scenarios. ID Requirement Acceptance contract Evidence state --- --- --- --- AC-CP-01 CP-01 With two nodes,any console shows the same IDs,roles,versions/JDK/architecture,capacity,heartbeat age and ownership;stale/unreachable nodes are explicitly marked. PASS AC-CP-02 CP-02 A task created/edited through A appears at B with the same global revision;IDs are unique within a cluster;independent sources remain isolated and standalone mode remains usable. PARTIAL · foundations AC-CP-03 CP-03 Any entry controls tasks on B;typed commands cover create/check/lifecycle/retry/validation/repair and carry request ID,revision and owner generation;duplicate delivery is idempotent and acceptance is distinct from execution. PARTIAL · foundations AC-CP-04 CP-04 Power loss,partition and stale-node return never permit dual writers;unconfirmed stops remain unknown/fenced;placement respects JDK,adapter,storage reachability and quotas;drain/move preserves progress. NOT RUN AC-CP-05 CP-05 Revocation at A is enforced at B;remote actions correlate by request/task/node/plan;secrets are not returned to UI and agents receive only authorized task references. PARTIAL · shared-access AC-CP-06 CP-06 UI filters node/task/destination status,lag,backlog,logs and errors with observation timestamps and bounded redacted log access. NOT RUN AC-CP-07 CP-07 Another entry survives controller failure;accepted commands recover;existing workers continue safely under documented policy;replica count/shared files alone are insufficient. DONE · separated profile AC-SE-01 SE-01 Reload/reopening the site restores an unexpired session and permissions without reentering the token;expired sessions return to login without unintended actions. PASS, single controller AC-SE-02 SE-02 Idle/absolute expiry is configurable;logout,disable,rotation and revocation invalidate sessions as specified;tabs agree;remembering across browser closure is a separate configurable policy. PASS, single controller AC-SE-03 SE-03 No readable long-lived browser credential;protected cookie/equivalent transport,HTTPS and HttpOnly/SameSite policy are verified;cookie-authenticated mutations enforce CSRF/Origin checks;session IDs never enter URLs/logs. PASS, single controller AC-SE-04 SE-04 Login at A remains valid at B;controller restart/failover follows expiry/recovery policy;revocation propagates as specified without relying on sticky sessions to hide missing state. DONE · shared-access AC-SE-05 SE-05 Existing API tokens work;conflicting cookie/header identities follow explicit rules;restoration rechecks grants and late responses cannot revive logout;messages are bilingual. PASS, single controller AC-RC-01 RC-01 Distinguish source/read,decode,DDL/normalization,apply,ack and journal failures;UI offers only valid retry/compensation/skip/gap-recovery actions for that stage. NOT RUN AC-RC-02 RC-02 Show source/transaction identity,event range,affected objects/destinations,raw/normalized hashes,before/after-image availability and checkpoints;bounded raw access is authorized and evidence is retained before action. Accepted bounded MySQL8.4/LOCAL fixed-Agent,PG/MySQL control profile;bcaae930 AC-RC-03 RC-03 For a known next failed transaction,ADMIN reviews destination scope/reason;cross-table events are not split;native SKIP receipt and safe progress commit locally and crash replay never skips another transaction. NOT RUN AC-RC-04 RC-04 Provide a separate verified transaction/source-range quarantine/exclusion plan affecting all relevant subscriptions with original logs retained;unprovable boundaries are refused with log recovery,valid source or rebaseline alternatives;never fabricate successful application. NOT RUN AC-RC-05 RC-05 If commit leads ACK,verify content and recover acknowledgment instead of compensating or declaring an unapplied skip;identity,generation,epoch,error/config/hash/checkpoint mismatches refuse action. PASS · bounded profile AC-RC-06 RC-06 Reconstruct initial affected identity state across repeated keys,PK moves,insert/delete chains,keyless occurrences,JSON/generated values;modify only reviewed scope;commit compensation/receipt atomically without rewriting the source transaction/GTID. PASS · bounded SQL AC-RC-07 RC-07 UI offers typed insert/update/delete and import preview;precision,NULL,keys and occurrence IDs are validated;review before/after scope/counts;refuse drift and unsafe keyless bulk edits;no implicit source writes or dependency bypass. PASS · bounded SQL AC-RC-08 RC-08 Track skipped transactions/ranges,destinations,reason,actor,hashes and original evidence;separate applied progress,safe coverage and running-with-gaps;only verification evidence closes a gap and accepted loss is not equality. PASS BOUNDED SQL;other products remain separate AC-RC-09 RC-09 Remote plans,approval,cancellation,receipts and evidence locations are traceable;controller/agent kill recovers the same request with idempotent commits/rollback;skip is not cutover approval. NOT RUN AC-RC-10 RC-10 Declare recovery capability per adapter;SQL uses local transactions,analytical/queue adapters verified receipts/gap notifications;other subscriptions are not silently skipped and unresolved evidence is retained with backpressure/alerts. NOT RUN AC-SO-01 SO-01 Each task declares source type,identity,namespace and version;GTID,LSN and SCN are not interchangeable;UI/preflight follow real capabilities and reject unsupported profiles. NOT RUN AC-SO-02 SO-02 Pin patch/driver/log settings and verify snapshot-to-CDC,object capabilities,restart/promotion/log loss,supported DDL/recovery with explicit negative cases and independent evidence. NOT RUN AC-SO-03 SO-03 Reverify current-release multi-database fan-out,types/generated columns,transactions,ASYNC/MGR,recovery/manual operations with explicit patch/topology scope. NOT RUN AC-SO-04 SO-04 Provide reproducible8.2 environment,version/auth/status/binlog handling and a complete first sync/recovery matrix;string matching/JDBC connectivity alone is insufficient. NOT RUN AC-SO-05 SO-05 Reverify supported current-release profiles and declare tagged/untagged GTID,anonymous events,row images,compression/partial-JSON capabilities or refusal;version labels are not blanket feature acceptance. NOT RUN AC-SO-06 SO-06 Implement consistent snapshot/LSN handoff,slots/publications,ordering/replay,replica identity,types/DDL and recovery;verify WAL/slot loss/promotion per version;expose GUI/CLI/docs. NOT RUN AC-SO-07 SO-07 Specify capture route,versions,privileges and driver distribution conditions;implement SCN snapshot,commit/rollback,redo/archive,DB identity/incarnation,checkpoint/replay;verify LOB,charset,PDB/RAC scope explicitly. NOT RUN AC-JV-01 JV-01 The candidate controller/agent/worker actually starts on all five JDKs with real JVM version,artifact hash,architecture and dependencies recorded;Java8 class/driver requirements are verified. NOT RUN AC-JV-02 JV-02 Each approved source profile crosses five JDKs for snapshot,CDC,restart and equality;record separate adapter/SDK/TLS/object/cluster/recovery gates and never label unrun combinations passed. NOT RUN AC-JV-03 JV-03 Verify service loading,reflection/modules,auth/TLS/certificates,reconnect,precision and vendor minimum JDK;incompatible combinations are explicitly refused,not inferred from compilation. NOT RUN AC-JV-04 JV-04 Provide five-JDK deployment profiles/placement constraints and verify command,event,state and rolling-upgrade compatibility;unsupported downgrade is refused with recovery guidance. NOT RUN AC-DO-01 DO-01 Each requirement has stable ID,status,gap,dependencies,priority,acceptance and task;ZH/EN IDs match and changes preserve evidence scope. NOT RUN AC-DO-02 DO-02 Provide runnable standalone/cluster examples for four deployment paths with stores,secrets/TLS,enrollment/drain,backup/restore/upgrades and local-storage boundaries;live K8s requires separate evidence. NOT RUN AC-DO-03 DO-03 Each scenario states symptoms,cause,UI/API steps,positions,gaps,idempotency/undo limits across promotion,log loss,SQL/ack,node/storage,session and manual recovery. NOT RUN AC-DO-04 DO-04 Document configuration,grants,codes,request/command/plan versions,source coordinates,consistency and source/sink/JDK profiles with examples/evidence;schema changes update both languages. NOT RUN AC-DO-05 DO-05 Check links,examples,APIs and bilingual coverage;completion links candidate hash/native evidence;DOM is not visual,static YAML is not live deployment,and builds are not adapter acceptance. NOT RUN AC-LG-01 LG-01 Record sync/recovery/manual capabilities by product,version,mode,distribution/index/driver/JDK;commercial distributed hardware is separately accepted,not inferred from PG protocol connectivity. NOT RUN AC-LG-02 LG-02 Implement adoption/difference planning,constraint restoration,final source cut,write handoff and failback conditions;dual-write/bidirectional conflict policy is separately specified. NOT RUN AC-LG-03 LG-03 Verify visibility,dedup/batch receipts,restart,old-backup,cluster and gaps per product without claiming ordinary SQL cross-table atomicity. NOT RUN AC-LG-04 LG-04 Each queue verifies lost confirmations,election,durable receipts,resource loss,consumer dedup/backlog and skip-gap protocol with honest delivery/consumption boundaries. NOT RUN AC-LG-05 LG-05 Local mode documents durable volume/pinning/disk-loss limits;external/shared modes are accepted per capability;move verifies logs,evidence,reports and secrets,not just cursors;independent journal infrastructure is not mandatory for every deployment. NOT RUN AC-LG-06 LG-06 Verify upgrade/scale,pod/node failure,RWO/CSI remount,secret rotation and stale-owner fencing on a real cluster with published configuration/evidence. NOT RUN AC-LG-07 LG-07 Bound memory/disk for large transactions/catalogs/slow sinks and publish multi-run hardware/workload results without linear extrapolation or count-only correctness. NOT RUN AC-LG-08 LG-08 Preserve source schema history,reviewed plans and identity keys;create first-release state directly without prerelease-candidate compatibility;verify current-state backup/restore,corruption refusal and product-specific limits. NOT RUN AC-LG-09 LG-09 Provide authorized report/receipt search,retention and active-file protection;real browsers verify cluster/session/confirmation/recovery/pagination and accessibility. NOT RUN AC-LG-10 LG-10 Verify external identity/revocation,external audit and distribution conditions;complete license/NOTICE/SBOM/contribution docs without claiming Apache affiliation or trademark rights. NOT RUN Cross-cutting scenarios and evidence Scenario Minimum checks --- --- Two-node control A controls B,owner failure/return,partition/unknown outcomes and requery,duplicate routing,global revocation Persistent login Reload,new tab,expiry,logout,cross-node route,controller reopen,grant changes,CSRF/identity conflicts;restoration triggers no task action Destination skip Multi-table transaction,explicit destinations,duplicates,receipt-before-ACK loss,stale generation/error,already-committed transaction,audit outage Capture/decode failure Proven/unproven boundaries,known/unknown impact,unreadable/purged logs,wrong source,all affected subscribers and refusal alternatives Patch/compensation Repeated keys,PK moves,insert/delete chains,keyless occurrence identity,NULL/JSON/time/numerics,schema/dependencies,drift,cancel/kill/retry Gap ledger Running remains visibly gapped,coverage is not applied;verification closes remediation while accepted loss stays distinct Deployment/upgrade Linux/Docker/Helm/nativeK8s,persistence/local disk,node/controller/volume faults,secret/config rotation,state migration or explicit refusal Existing source/runtime evidence,not new tests Source profile Java8 Java11/17/21/25 Whole current platform --- --- --- --- MySQL5.7 Basic historical5.7.44 Dedicated source-version evidence missing PARTIAL MySQL8.0 Historical8.0.46 V2/HA Dedicated source-version evidence missing PARTIAL;current V3/recovery needed MySQL8.2 No dedicated complete evidence found Same NEW MySQL8.4 Current representative SQL/repair paths Older one-table SQL benchmark only PARTIAL PostgreSQL source Not implemented Not implemented NEW;sink evidence is unrelated Oracle source Not implemented Not implemented NEW Each approved profile crosses five JDKs;targets,auth/TLS,types,journals,topology and faults are separate dimensions. Historical entries cannot become blanket support. Initial exact PG/Oracle versions/modes remain design decisions. Release evidence fields Requirement/task/case IDs,candidate SHA,node/agent protocol,actual product/version/mode,JVM/architecture,driver,storage/durability,scope/workload,before/after coordinates,receipt/gap IDs,positive/refusal/duplicate/interruption outcomes,raw-log location,redaction,manual links and residual limits. Distinguish NOT RUN,PASSED,FAILED,EXPERIMENTAL,UNSUPPORTED;having a script is not PASSED. 2026-11-17: Public fixed-owner routing/CDC evidence; incomplete maintenance projection/migration/HA remain tracked, without changing DONE counts.

title: 验收矩阵
text: SDD验收矩阵 RM-SDD-001 · 2026-11-17 这些合同持续追踪验收状态。CP-01、SE-01/02/03/04/05、CP-07、RC-02和RC-05限定档案已验收；CP-05部分完成，其余范围仍待验收。Given=满足规格中的受支持档案及权限；When=执行对应正常、错误或中断操作；Then=满足下列可观察结果。每项至少包含正常、拒绝、重复请求及相关重启/切换场景。 ID 需求 验收合同 证据状态 --- --- --- --- AC-CP-01 CP-01 部署两个节点后，任一管理入口均显示相同节点ID、角色、版本/JDK/架构、容量、心跳时间和任务归属；失联显示过期/未知，不能伪装成健康。 PASS AC-CP-02 CP-02 同一集群中从A创建/修改任务后B读到同一全局修订；全局taskId唯一，独立任务与源配置仍隔离；单机模式保留可运行配置。 PARTIAL · foundations AC-CP-03 CP-03 任一入口可控制B的任务：创建、检查、启停、暂停/恢复、重试、校验/修复；命令含全局请求ID/修订/owner代次，重复投递只生效一次，202仅表示接受，返回已执行/拒绝/未知结果。 PARTIAL · foundations AC-CP-04 CP-04 节点断电/网络分区/旧节点恢复时同一任务无双写；未确认停机可标记未知并隔离；按JDK、连接器、存储可达性和配额调度；排空迁移保留断点。 待验收 AC-CP-05 CP-05 从A撤销权限后B拒绝新命令；同一远端操作可按请求ID/任务/节点/计划追踪；界面不返回密钥，节点仅获得授权任务必需的密钥引用。 PARTIAL · shared-access AC-CP-06 CP-06 界面按节点/任务/目标过滤状态、延迟、积压、日志和错误；注明采集时间及失联范围；远端日志分页/限流且不泄露业务值或凭据。 待验收 AC-CP-07 CP-07 管理实例故障后其他入口可继续查询/控制；接收但未完成的命令可恢复；按明确策略已有Worker可继续安全同步；仅部署多个replica或共享目录不能算通过。 DONE · separated profile AC-SE-01 SE-01 登录后刷新、重新打开同一站点页面可恢复未过期会话和原权限，不需再次输入令牌；过期则回到登录页且不误发操作。 通过：单控制器 AC-SE-02 SE-02 可配置空闲/绝对有效期；退出、账号停用、令牌轮换或权限撤销按策略失效；多标签页一致；浏览器关闭后的持久记住登录为单独可配置策略。 通过：单控制器 AC-SE-03 SE-03 浏览器端不保存可读的长期认证令牌；会话标识采用受保护cookie/等效方案，生产HTTPS及HttpOnly/SameSite策略可验证；cookie鉴权写操作具备CSRF/Origin检查；会话不进URL或日志。 通过：单控制器 AC-SE-04 SE-04 登录A后请求落到B仍合法；重启/切换控制实例按有效期恢复；集群撤销即时按规定传播，不以粘性会话掩盖状态缺失。 DONE · shared-access AC-SE-05 SE-05 既有CLI/API令牌可继续使用；cookie与Authorization身份冲突有明确拒绝/优先规则；会话恢复重验权限，晚到响应不能复活退出会话，双语提示一致。 通过：单控制器 AC-RC-01 RC-01 分别展示源连接/读取、解码、DDL/规范化、目标应用、确认及日志存储错误；UI给出该阶段可用的重试、补偿、事务跳过或缺口恢复路径，不能把所有binlog故障当目标SQL错误。 待验收 AC-RC-02 RC-02 显示源身份、完整事务ID、事件范围、表/目标、原始及规范化摘要、前后镜像可用性和当前断点；原始值仅授权角色可读并分页限额；执行前保留可恢复证据。
