title: RC-05: failed-transaction native checkpoint reconciliation
text: RC-05: failed-transaction native checkpoint reconciliation Status: RC-05 bounded profile accepted;see evidence. RC-02 historical evidence semantics remain unchanged;skip and compensation remain separate. Delivery order: expose a read-only comparison in transaction review; add authorized, drift-checked, idempotent acknowledgment of verified commits; make the check mandatory for later skip/compensation operations and accept the complete UI workflow. Read-only comparison The initial production profile is transactional PostgreSQL and MySQL destinations. Derive connections, subscriptions and mappings from the current task configuration. Verify its fingerprint and the journal subscription set. Open existing metadata only: no initialization, activation, normalization, ACK or resume. Read the paused head before and after native I/O. Both observations must exactly match retained evidence, including source position, raw/normalized transactions, generation, owner epoch, subscription ACK, error generation/code and diagnostic. Require an existing normalized transaction; never reconstruct history from current source rows or allocate new keyless identities. Automatic apply and recovery share TransactionProjection . Preserve complete transaction identity and BARRIER events, filter by destination mappings, and compute the native transaction hash using referenced historical schema versions. Native checkpoint Result Meaning --- --- --- Equal to journal ACK CHECKPOINT NOT ADVANCED Does not prove absent business data or authorize skipping ACK+1 with identical transaction ID and projected hash COMMITTED UNACKNOWLEDGED Reconcile acknowledgment; do not compensate/relabel as an unapplied skip Invalid sequence, mismatched content or native epoch ahead Refuse Investigate divergence, wrong target or external writes Native epoch behind targetFenceRequired Read-only inspection does not activate; later mutation must fence first Return evidence ID/hash, observation time and both checkpoints. This is a historical observation, never a durable execution approval. The UI must label it accordingly and handle older Agents returning no checkpoint field. Manual acknowledgment constraints Recheck current authority, configuration, evidence and native checkpoint at execution. Hold journal job/subscription locks against ownership and resume changes; hold the native checkpoint row lock against concurrent apply. Commit journal ACK and a durable operation receipt atomically. Keep the subscription paused and increment its error generation. Repeated operation IDs return the original receipt without rewriting business rows. The current confirmation refuses a lagging native epoch;complete fencing through the existing pause workflow and retain fresh evidence before retrying. Do not commit ACK while depending on an uncommitted native epoch update. This operation confirms a proven native APPLY; it does not fabricate a SKIP. New cross-node mutations require explicit protocol/capability admission before routing to Agents. Focused acceptance Cover real commits leading ACK; ID/hash mismatches; mapping filters, empty projections and BARRIER; missing normalization/history; changed error/epoch/config; concurrent resume; missing metadata without recreation; lagging epoch without activation; and summaries without row values. Run related H2/native SQL and DOM contracts first, then the complete feature's end-to-end and compatibility gates. First manual-ACK profile Require the entire pipeline PAUSED,not only the failing subscriber. Pause first advances the journal epoch and revokes old Workers;confirm destination fencing,then retain fresh evidence. At execution hold job/subscription and native checkpoint locks,require equal fenced epochs,commit ACK plus receipt atomically and leave both pauses in place. No automatic activation occurs in confirmation. A lagging destination requires retrying the existing pause/fence procedure and new evidence. The transactional implementation,HTTP/UI and protocol6 admission passed the bounded profile;see the guide.

title: RC-05：失败事务原生断点核对
text: RC-05：失败事务原生断点核对 状态：RC-05 限定档案已验收，见证据。原有 RC-02 历史证据语义不变，跳过与补偿另行追踪。 交付顺序 1. 在已保存的完整失败事务基础上，核对当前日志与目标原生断点，并在事务审阅界面显示结果。 2. 对已经提交但日志尚未确认的事务，提供经过权限、漂移检查和幂等保护的确认操作。 3. 将该检查作为后续跳过与补偿的强制前置条件，完成对应界面和故障验收。 只读核对 第一档案为事务型 PostgreSQL、MySQL 目标。生产入口从当前任务配置派生目标连接、订阅和数据库映射，核实配置指纹与日志订阅集合；只打开既有原生元数据，不建表、不 activate、不 normalize、不推进 ACK、不恢复订阅。 核对前后两次读取暂停事务，均须与签名证据中的完整观察一致，包括源位置、原始及规范化事务、流水线世代、所有者 epoch、订阅 ACK、错误版本、错误代码和故障诊断。发现变化即拒绝。只有已保存的规范化事务能够参与计算，不以重新查询源行或重新分配无主键标识代替历史内容。 自动应用与恢复核对共用 TransactionProjection 。它保留事务边界和 BARRIER，按目标数据库映射筛选事件，并用历史表版本计算目标事务摘要。 原生断点 结果 含义 --- --- --- 等于日志 ACK CHECKPOINT NOT ADVANCED 原生断点未前进；不能据此断言业务行不存在或允许跳过 等于 ACK+1，事务 ID、投影摘要全部相同 COMMITTED UNACKNOWLEDGED 目标已提交，日志尚未确认；不得重放补偿或当作未应用事务跳过 序号越界、事务内容不符、目标 epoch 领先 拒绝 需要排查漂移、错误目标或外部写入 目标 epoch 落后 标记 targetFenceRequired 只读核对不更新 epoch；任何后续写操作必须先完成围栏 结果必须带证据 ID/摘要、观察时间和双方断点。它是有时间点的观察，不能作为后续操作的永久凭据。界面不把历史结果标成当前状态；旧执行节点不返回新字段时显示核对不可用。 人工确认的执行约束 执行时重新核对权限、配置、证据和原生断点。日志 job/subscription 锁保护恢复和所有权变动，原生目标断点锁阻止提交漂移；ACK 与持久化操作回执在同一个日志事务中提交。保持订阅暂停，产生新错误版本使旧恢复请求失效。相同操作 ID 重试返回原回执，崩溃后不得重复写业务行。 当前确认操作在原生 epoch 落后时拒绝执行，要求通过原有暂停流程完成原生围栏并保存新证据后再试。不能在日志 ACK 提交后才依赖一个尚未提交的原生 epoch 更新。ACK 确认只适用于已经验证的原生 APPLY 提交，不得伪造 SKIP。跨节点新增写操作须显式版本/能力准入，避免旧 Agent 接收未知操作。 针对性验收 覆盖真实业务事务提交领先 ACK、相同 ID/不同摘要、映射过滤、空投影和 BARRIER、缺失规范化内容、历史模式缺失、错误版本/epoch/config 变化、核对期间恢复、缺失元数据不重建、目标 epoch 落后只报告、输出不含行值。先做相关 H2/原生 SQL 合同与 DOM 验证；完整恢复功能交付时再跑对应端到端和兼容矩阵。 首个人工确认档案 要求整个流水线 PAUSED，仅目标暂停不够。先暂停任务，推进日志 epoch 并撤销旧 Worker；确认原生目标围栏，再保存新证据。执行时持有 job/subscription 与原生断点锁，要求双方围栏 epoch 相等，ACK 与操作回执原子提交，并保持双层暂停。确认操作不自动 activate；目标围栏落后时需重试现有暂停/围栏流程后重新保存证据。内部事务、HTTP/UI 与协议6准入已通过限定档案验收；操作方式见手册。

title: Control store design
text: CP-01/02/03: shared control storage and node registry 中文. Establish the contract before implementation/acceptance. Node visibility alone does not provide global task control. Standalone local mode remains the default. Explicit cluster configuration selects a separate SQL control namespace: PostgreSQL/MySQL initially, with H2 for protocol tests. Control metadata and CDC journals/business targets have different roles; separate namespaces may reuse an SQL instance. Use dedicated credentials and bounded connections/queries; never expose connection URLs, credentials or business data in the UI. rmc cluster stores clusterId, protocol format and a consistent lease duration. Incompatible settings refuse startup. rmc node stores stable nodeId, process incarnation, registration epoch, database-clock heartbeat/lease, lifecycle state and actual version/JVM/architecture/capacity. Registration serializes capacity checks on the cluster row. Another process cannot overwrite an active nodeId. Heartbeat and shutdown check incarnation/epoch so stale processes cannot renew or change a replacement's row. Database time determines expiry. rmc node task initially contains only whitelisted observations: task ID, revision, desired/Worker state and observation time. It is not global task authority and cannot authorize scheduling/recovery. Duplicate observed task IDs indicate a conflict; they do not establish uniqueness or failover. Global configuration/commands, idempotent receipts, execution fencing, shared accounts/audit and shared sessions remain CP-02/03/04/05/07 and SE-04 work. Registry reads use a consistent database snapshot and return observation time, heartbeat, expiry, HEALTHY/STALE/STOPPED, epoch and real version/JVM/architecture/CPU/heap/configured capacity. Keyset pagination and bounded node/task counts limit responses. Expired records remain visibly stale; storage failure returns503 rather than claiming cached health. Initially only ADMIN can inspect global node/task observations. VIEWER/OPERATOR retain existing task permissions. The UI distinguishes registry visibility from local task operations until remote commands are implemented. Filesystem paths, secrets and raw logs are excluded. Registry leases do not replace CDC/target Worker fencing. Startup validates/creates the control schema, registers and starts a bounded independent heartbeat thread. Graceful shutdown stops heartbeats and marks only its own incarnation STOPPED. Kill/power loss becomes STALE through database expiry. Control-store failure affects readiness and registry requests; existing Workers retain their journal lease behavior without global takeover commands. Acceptance covers independent local directories sharing the registry, concurrent registration, active-ID collision, expiry/replacement, stale heartbeat/shutdown refusal, server time/capacity/pagination, redaction and HTTP roles. Native PostgreSQL/MySQL two-node startup/kill/reopen/storage-outage checks, current artifact/UI and bilingual operations are required. Passing the registry closes only CP-01.

title: 共享控制库设计
text: CP-01/02/03：共享控制状态与节点目录 English。此文先固定协议合同，再实现和验收；节点目录完成不代表全局任务控制完成。 存储和身份 保留默认单机本地模式。显式启用 cluster 后使用单独 SQL 控制命名空间，首批为 PostgreSQL/MySQL；H2 用于协议测试。共享控制状态与业务目标/CDC 日志是不同职责，可按独立命名空间复用 SQL 实例。连接使用专用凭据、限时连接/查询，不把 URL、凭据或业务数据返回页面。 rmc cluster 记录 clusterId、协议格式和统一租约期限；同集群不兼容设置拒绝启动。 rmc node 记录稳定 nodeId、进程 incarnation、注册 epoch、数据库时钟心跳/租约、退出状态及版本/JVM/架构/容量。注册容量在集群行锁下检查；活动 nodeId 不允许另一进程覆盖。心跳和退出均校验 incarnation/epoch；旧进程不能续租或改写新进程记录。数据库时间是失联判定依据，客户端时钟不参与授权。 rmc node task 第一阶段仅保存白名单任务观察：任务ID、控制修订、期望状态、Worker状态、观察时间。它不是全局任务权威表，也不授权恢复/调度。重复 taskId 可在观察中显示冲突；不能靠该表声称全局唯一或执行接管。全局配置/命令、幂等回执、owner fencing、权限/审计与跨控制器会话在 CP-02/03/04/05/07 和 SE-04 后续实现。 节点视图 管理入口使用数据库一致快照查询同一节点目录，返回服务器观察时间、最近心跳、租约到期、HEALTHY/STALE/STOPPED、node epoch、真实版本/JVM/架构/CPU/堆和配置容量。节点及任务观察按节点ID游标分页，节点数量和每节点任务数有上限。过期记录明确标识，不删除成“没问题”，目录不可达返回503，不能把缓存视图当成健康。 第一阶段只向 ADMIN 提供全局节点/任务观察，保留 VIEWER/OPERATOR 原任务权限。页面清楚标识节点目录与本机任务操作范围；后续远端控制接入后再改变任务视图语义。独立节点配置/密钥/日志路径不写入目录。节点租约不替代现有 CDC/目标 Worker fencing。 生命周期及测试 启动建立/检查控制 schema，注册节点，启动有界独立心跳线程；关闭停止心跳并以本代身份标记 STOPPED。断电/kill 后由数据库租约判为 STALE。控制库中断时 readiness 失效，目录请求503；本阶段既有 Worker 继续遵循其同步日志租约，尚不接受全局接管命令。 验收包括：两个独立本地目录的服务读取同一节点目录；并发注册、活动ID碰撞、过期替换、旧进程续租/退出拒绝；数据库时间与容量；分页和无凭据投影；HTTP权限；真实 PostgreSQL/MySQL 双节点启动、kill/重开及控制库存储中断恢复；最新UI、制品及双语运维说明。目录观察通过后只关闭 CP-01，不关闭其他集群条目。

title: CP-07: management and execution lifecycle separation (separated profile accepted)
text: CP-07: management and execution lifecycle separation (separated profile accepted) Protocol4 implements independent CONTROLLER/AGENT and compatible COMBINED profiles.The declared LOCAL-journal profile completes CP-07 acceptance.Combined mode still owns HTTP and local Workers in one process;container termination affects its Workers.Only the explicit separated profile provides the tested independent lifecycle.Automatic execution takeover and the complete matrix remain separate. Responsibilities Provide explicit controller, execution-agent and compatible combined profiles. Controllers serve authorized APIs/sessions/configuration and submit queries without restoring local Workers. Agents retain the fixed-owner private directory, execute durable commands, publish observations and answer typed reads. Their probe endpoint must not expose administration APIs. Combined mode preserves the existing single-deployment experience. Roles describe responsibility, not tenant isolation. Agents remain in the trusted control domain with documented control-store/key/native-journal access. Workers still filter controller credentials. Adding a role string does not establish least-secret or OS isolation. Identity and upgrades Stable nodeId plus original private-directory UUID remain authoritative. Controllers cannot be execution owners; an old Agent binding cannot allow new tasks after a node changes to controller-only. Roles/execution capability must participate in the shared membership protocol so old members cannot bypass admission. Define mixed-version refusal, graceful-stop prerequisites, directory restoration, coordinated backup and rollback limits. Splitting an existing combined node preserves owner/checkpoints/targets/reports. Its directory belongs only to an Agent keeping the original nodeId. A controller-only node must refuse an existing execution directory with tasks. An empty directory does not authorize deleting historical authority. Fault semantics Controller exit/SIGKILL leaves independent Agent/Workers running when the selected journal/lease/target protocol permits it; other entries continue observation and durable admission. Losing every controller does not imply STOP. Agent exit still requires explicit stop/unknown/original-owner recovery rules. Automatic relocation and stale-Worker fencing remain CP-04. Control-store failure never falls back to local mutation. Continued CDC depends on native journal/fencing and requires actual tests. Heartbeat expiry does not prove Worker termination. Probes, close ordering and deadlines must not launch unobserved Workers. Minimum acceptance Two controller JVMs plus an independent Agent/Worker and real SQL business data: create through A for the Agent, query/control through B; kill A while CDC continues; lose every controller while verifying the declared data-plane policy; restore management with identical task/positions/reports. Revocation and control-store outages still reject invalid commands. Agent exit/kill/original-directory reopen, wrong roles/empty directories/old members need positive and negative cases. Document Linux/Docker/Helm/native process/storage profiles; live Kubernetes/CSI acceptance is separate. 中文 · Current global control 2026-11-17: protocol4 implementation and declared LOCAL-journal lifecycle accepted. Evidence. Current deployment instructions and remaining limits are in the operations guide.

title: CP-07：管理入口与执行生命周期分离（分离档案已验收）
text: CP-07：管理入口与执行生命周期分离（分离档案已验收） 协议4已实现独立CONTROLLER/AGENT及兼容COMBINED档案，并完成限定LOCAL日志档案的CP-07验收。组合进程仍同时承担HTTP和本机Worker管理，关闭其容器会影响本机Worker；只有显式分离档案具备本合同验证的独立生命周期。自动执行接管和完整矩阵仍单独追踪。 进程职责 提供显式管理入口、执行Agent及兼容组合档案。管理入口只有授权API/会话/配置与查询提交，不启动或恢复本机Worker；Agent持有固定owner私有目录，执行持久命令、发布观察和回答类型化只读查询，管理API不得暴露在Agent探针端口。组合档案保留现有单部署体验。 角色表示进程职责，不是多租户安全隔离。Agent仍在可信控制域，控制库/任务密钥与原生日志权限必须说明；Worker继续过滤控制凭据。不能因增加role字符串而声称已经实现最小密钥或操作系统隔离。 持久身份及升级 owner仍由稳定nodeId和原私有目录UUID绑定。管理节点不得被选为owner，历史Agent绑定不能使改成纯管理角色的节点继续接受任务。角色及可执行能力必须参与共享成员协议校验；旧成员不能绕过新规则创建无执行者的任务。升级必须定义混合版本拒绝、正常停止成员的条件、原目录恢复、备份及回退边界。 已有组合节点拆分时，不修改任务owner/断点/目标或报告身份；原执行目录只能交给保留原nodeId的Agent。含任务的目录不能以纯管理角色悄悄打开。控制节点没有任务目录不等于可以删除历史权威绑定。 故障语义 管理入口退出或强杀后，独立Agent及Worker在其受支持日志/租约/目标协议允许时继续；其他入口仍可查询、提交和观察持久命令。所有管理入口失联也不得让Agent猜测任务已停止。Agent退出仍需要明确停止/未知和原owner恢复语义，自动迁移及旧Worker隔离仍属CP-04。 共享控制库中断不得回退到本机修改。是否继续已有CDC取决于数据面日志和原生隔离，必须实测；节点心跳过期不证明Worker终止。探针、退出顺序及超时不能留下无人监管的新Worker。 最低验收 两个管理JVM加独立Agent/Worker和真实SQL业务：A创建给Agent、B查询/控制；杀A时CDC继续，杀全部管理入口时CDC按已声明策略继续；管理恢复后看到同一任务、位点与报告；跨入口撤销和控制库中断仍拒绝非法命令。Agent关闭、容器强杀、原目录重开、错误角色/空目录/旧成员均有正常及拒绝测试。Linux/Docker/Helm/原生YAML分别给出进程与存储配置；K8s/CSI实测独立登记。 English · 当前全局控制 2026-11-17: protocol4 implementation and declared LOCAL-journal lifecycle accepted. Evidence. Current deployment instructions and remaining limits are in the operations guide.

title: Failed-transaction recovery contract
text: Failed-transaction recovery contract RM-SDD-001 · RC-01—RC-10 · 2026-11-17 · 中文 This contract governs upcoming recovery work. It does not accept skip or patch operations; requirements.json remains authoritative. 1. Record phases at their execution sites: target activation, journal read, normalization, projection, receipt reconciliation, apply and journal ACK are distinct. Legacy records without a phase remain UNKNOWN, never inferred to permit skipping. 2. Persist subscriber pause and its bounded diagnostic in one journal transaction, bound to the error generation. Repeated pause preserves the first fault; a failure after resume receives a new generation. Diagnostics contain no exception messages, SQL, connection strings or business values. 3. Inspect only the next complete transaction of a paused subscriber, atomically binding error generation, ACK, stream generation, epoch, configuration fingerprint and content hashes. Inspection never acknowledges, activates a sink, normalizes events or changes keyless identities. Missing history, no next transaction and corrupt content are explicit refusals. 4. Raw and existing normalized payloads share a read budget. Reject oversized transactions completely rather than approving a truncated transaction. Enforce character/byte bounds independently of stored length. The initial internal limit is 4 MiB; streaming review of large transactions remains open. 5. Inspection is a current snapshot, not an execution credential. Authorization, private durable evidence, destination projection hashes, native checkpoint reconciliation and retention must precede execution APIs. A paused ACK pins current history; an in-memory result cannot substitute for retained evidence after resume/collection. 6. Execution plans bind original owner/directory, configuration revision, stream generation/epoch, error generation, ACK, complete transaction and destination checkpoint. Reconcile a verified destination commit ahead of ACK first. Unknown commits or mismatched hashes prohibit skip/compensation. 7. Skip one destination's whole transaction. Commit a native SKIP receipt and safe progress atomically; commit journal ACK and gap atomically. Restart reconciles both receipts under the original request, never skipping twice or interpreting SKIP as APPLY. A format/capability upgrade must force old software to refuse incompatible checkpoints before mutation is exposed. 8. Compensation plans show typed before/after values and row identities, recheck drift and atomically commit data with native receipts. They do not rewrite source logs/reset positions or automatically resume. 9. Gaps distinguish unresolved, accepted loss and verified closure. Show safe coverage separately from actual application. Other destinations are unaffected. Retain unresolved gaps/review evidence and apply backpressure at quota. 10. UI operations use durable cross-node requests, shared authorization and audit. Raw values require separate authorization, pagination and limits. Gate new request kinds on tested old-Agent refusal/capability negotiation. Initial acceptance: activation is not labeled APPLY; a failure on transaction two identifies transaction two; uncertain commits cannot authorize skip; inspection survives journal restart; stale generation/running-state requests refuse; corruption, missing sequence, over-budget and forged length refuse without changing ACK; concurrent resume/collection cannot yield a mixed snapshot. Native receipts, crash windows, UI, authorization and fan-out acceptance follow separately.

title: 失败事务恢复契约
text: 失败事务恢复契约 RM-SDD-001 · RC-01—RC-10 · 2026-11-17 · English 本契约约束接下来的人工恢复实现，不代表跳过或补数据已经验收。各项完成状态以 requirements.json 为准。 1. 故障阶段由执行位置记录，不根据 SQL 异常类推断。目标激活、日志读取、规范化、目标投影、目标凭据核对、目标应用和日志确认是不同阶段。旧记录没有阶段时显示 UNKNOWN，不能推测为可跳过。 2. 暂停订阅及其失败诊断同一日志事务提交，绑定错误版本。重复暂停保留首次故障；重试后再次失败生成新版本。诊断不保存异常消息、SQL、连接串或业务行值。 3. 检查只读取已暂停订阅的下一完整事务，原子绑定订阅错误版本、ACK、日志世代、epoch、配置指纹和内容摘要。检查不确认事务，不激活目标、不规范化事件，也不修改无主键身份。没有下一事务、历史丢失或内容损坏必须明确拒绝。 4. 原始及已存在的规范化内容一起受读取配额限制。超限整次拒绝，不截断为可批准的事务。读取有字符/字节上限，不能仅信任可损坏的存储长度。这里的初始内部接口上限为 4 MiB，不代表大事务流式审阅已经实现。 5. 读到的内容仅是当前快照，不是执行凭证。授权、私有持久证据、目标投影摘要、原生断点核对和保留策略完成前，不开放执行入口。暂停 ACK 保留当前日志；恢复并回收后，内存中的检查结果不能作为历史凭证。 6. 执行计划必须绑定原始 owner/目录身份、配置修订、日志世代/epoch、错误版本、ACK、完整事务和目标断点。目标已提交领先 ACK 时，先核对完整内容并恢复确认。断点不明或摘要不符时拒绝跳过/补偿。 7. 跳过只针对一个目标的完整事务。目标原生 SKIP 凭据与安全进度原子提交；日志 ACK 与缺口记录原子提交。重启通过原始请求核对两端凭据，不能重复跳过，也不能把 SKIP 当 APPLY。开放前必须升级数据格式/能力协议，使旧程序拒绝错误解释新断点。 8. 补偿计划显示类型化前后值及影响身份，执行前重验目标漂移；数据与原生补偿凭据原子提交。补偿不改写源日志，不自动重置源位点，不自动恢复任务。 9. 缺口区分待修复、接受丢失及经验证关闭。安全覆盖进度与真实已应用进度分别展示；其他目标不隐式跳过。未解决缺口及待审证据不能静默回收，容量不足时背压。 10. 管理界面使用跨节点持久请求、共享权限及审计；原始业务值单独授权、分页和限额。新请求类型发布前必须建立旧 Agent 拒绝/能力协商测试。不能只在本机界面实现。 首批验收：目标激活失败不冒充 APPLY；第二个事务应用失败准确定位第二个事务；不确定提交不能批准跳过；暂停检查在重启后读取相同内容；旧版本检查/运行中检查拒绝；原始或规范化损坏、序列丢失、超限、长度伪报拒绝且 ACK 不变；并发恢复/回收不能产生混合快照。后续再逐项补原生凭据、强杀窗口、UI、权限和多目标验收。

title: Durable failed-transaction evidence
text: Durable failed-transaction evidence RC-02/05/09 · 2026-11-17 · 中文 This extends the recovery contract without exposing skip or compensation writes. - Retain immutable review IDs in the original execution node's private directory. Bind task,owner/directory identity,configuration revision,actor,time,stream generation/epoch,error generation,ACK,whole raw/normalized hashes and historical schemas. Evidence is not current execution authorization. - Use private directories/files(0700/0600),bounded reads and no symlinks/path escape. Verify HMAC with a separate random key. Missing keys,corruption or identity mismatch refuse;never replace a lost key to silently accept old records. Back up keys and directory identity together. - Repeating an ID returns its original record;changed identity/request/destination conflicts. Private temporary files,fsync,atomic publication and directory fsync prevent partial valid records. Cross-process locking serializes quota checks/publication. - Enforce per-record and directory byte/count quotas. Refuse at quota without silently deleting evidence;unresolved gaps cannot be garbage-collected. Document temporary-file/physical-space limits. - Persist and verify before returning a review ID. Current journal inspection alone is not retained evidence. Retained records survive journal collection. Missing historical schemas cannot support execution plans. - Summaries contain no row values or SQL. Bound raw/normalized event pages;refuse a single oversized event rather than approving truncated images. Missing normalization is explicit;reading must not mutate journal/keyless identities. - Before global UI integration,gate new requests on protocol/capabilities so old Agents cannot consume unknown recovery commands. Creation is durable under the original request/review ID;queries reauthorize/audit. Copying files does not implicitly implement Agent migration. Acceptance covers restart,idempotency/conflicts,tampered content/key,changed directory identity,symlinks,quota preserving old evidence,concurrent publication,write interruption,safe summaries,pagination and journal GC survival. Native checkpoint reconciliation/execution drift checks remain RC-05:complete evidence alone cannot prove non-commit or authorize skipping. UI/protocol integration (bounded profile accepted) Global control opts into protocol5 with cluster.recoveryReview: true ,requiring sharedTasks/sharedAccess. Defaultoff preserves protocols3/4;durable command and owner-query admission reject new evidence requests. Upgrade requires old members normally STOPPED,not merely expired;old modes cannot rejoin protocol5. Standalone entry has no old Agent routing and still requires administrators. A durable FAILURE REVIEW action binds destination/error generation and persists evidence ID/original configuration revision before execution. Summary GET and raw/normalized event POST bind original execution directory,reauthorize/audit and limit pages to256KiB/100events. They never automatically resume. Global operation views preserve review IDs. UI opens summaries first,requires explicit raw access,closes on logout and discards stale session responses. Managed review acceptance:protocol5 fixed-Agent MySQL8.4/LOCAL profile;manual mutation and other profiles remain separate.

title: 失败事务持久证据
text: 失败事务持久证据 RC-02/05/09 · 2026-11-17 · English 本设计接续恢复契约，不开放跳过或补偿写入。 - 原始证据位于原执行节点私有目录，以不可变审阅ID保存。内容绑定任务ID、原owner及目录身份、配置修订、操作者、时间、日志世代/epoch、错误版本、ACK、完整原始/规范化事务摘要；保留解释事件所需的历史结构。文件不是当前执行授权。 - 原始值只保存在私有文件，目录0700、文件0600。禁止符号链接、越界路径和超限读取。独立随机密钥校验HMAC；密钥丢失、签名/摘要损坏、身份不符均拒绝，不能生成新密钥后静默接受旧证据。备份必须包含密钥和目录身份。 - 同一审阅ID的重复请求返回原记录；身份、请求内容或目标不同则冲突。写入采用私有临时文件、fsync、原子发布及目录fsync；进程中断后只能读到完整原记录或没有记录，不能读到半份有效证据。跨进程锁保护配额和发布。 - 每条与整个证据目录分别设字节/数量配额。配额满时明确拒绝，不自动删掉旧证据；未解决缺口不得静默回收。临时文件和物理空间边界需要在运维中说明。 - 当前事务检查结果不是长期证据。必须先完成持久化和校验，才返回可审阅ID；以后即使原日志被回收，已保留证据仍可按原摘要读出。缺失历史结构不能形成可执行计划。 - 摘要不含行值或SQL；原始/规范化事件采用有界分页，单事件超页限额时明确拒绝，不能截断镜像再批准。审阅缺少规范化内容时明确标注，不在读取时更改日志或无主键身份。 - 接入全局界面前，新请求必须有能力/协议门禁，旧Agent不能消费未知恢复命令。创建证据采用持久操作，按原请求/审阅ID恢复；查询仍重验共享权限及审计。跨Agent搬迁不由文件复制隐式实现。 验收至少覆盖：重启后读取、相同ID幂等/冲突、内容和密钥损坏、目录身份变化、符号链接、配额不删除旧证据、并发发布、写入中断、摘要无原始值、分页边界，以及日志回收后仍可审阅。目标原生断点核对与执行前漂移检查另属RC-05；即使证据完整，也不能据此断言未提交或批准跳过。 界面与协议接入（限定档案已验收） 共享全局控制显式配置 cluster.recoveryReview: true 后使用控制协议5；要求sharedTasks/sharedAccess。默认关闭时保留原协议3/4和已有请求，创建/查询新证据在持久命令及owner查询入口拒绝。升级要求旧成员正常STOPPED，过期租约不等于正常停止；协议5建立后旧模式拒绝加入。单机入口不涉及旧Agent，仍需管理员权限。 创建使用 FAILURE REVIEW 持久动作，沿用目标及错误版本，执行前保存审阅ID及原配置修订。查询为摘要GET与原始/规范化事件POST，绑定原执行目录，限额256KiB/100事件，重验权限并审计；不会自动恢复任务。全局操作视图必须保留审阅ID，不能只返回已成功状态。UI默认展示摘要，原始值需显式点击；退出后关闭审阅内容，晚到响应不得复活旧会话。 Managed review acceptance:protocol5 fixed-Agent MySQL8.4/LOCAL profile;manual mutation and other profiles remain separate.

title: Gap verification: common cut and atomic records
text: Gap verification: common cut and atomic records 中文 · Tasks · RC-08 DONE · 限定SQL档案 / bounded SQL profile Plans,administrator API/UI,cross-node approval and cancellation are integrated. PostgreSQL/MySQL each pass58 native contracts and103 DOM checks pass;27 real-CDC checks pass with each PG/MySQL control store and the bounded RC-08 SQL profile is accepted. See the operator guide and FAQ. Reviewed scope A plan binds one destination,configuration fingerprint,journal generation,source identity,common cut,sealed report and source roots. It covers at most100 existing gaps and1000 affected tables. Each gap requires its complete transaction plan and native execution receipt. Historical schema versions must match the common cut. Different source,destination,generation,schema or cut,and incomplete/differing reports are refused. Plans contain metadata,not business row values. A historical MATCH only permits preparing a plan. Execution freshly scans every affected destination table and uses bounded disk sorting to compare row counts and content roots against sealed source data. Counts alone or only the skipped transaction's rows are insufficient. Differences,timeouts,moved native checkpoints or source pause fences prevent a successful record. Concurrency and persistence The source job row stays locked throughout original-gap inspection,fresh destination scans and source-record commit. Resume,Worker ownership changes and service repair mutations must take the same fence. Native target epochs/common-cut checks also fence stale Workers. Tables need not fit in memory. Destination business data must be exclusively written by the sync service. Direct application/administrator writes are outside this fence. Future manual-data correction must acquire the same fence. Verification compares the sealed historical source cut,not the source's current live state. The source journal adds immutable rm3 gap verification plan plans and successful rm3 gap verification receipts and stores a verification ID/hash on rm3 gap . One source transaction writes the receipt and all selected gap links;any failure rolls everything back. Original SKIP plans,receipts,gaps and reports remain unchanged. Verification does not issue business DML,advance ACK or resume execution. VERIFIED AT COMMON CUT records the reviewed plan,cut,observation time,execution request,approver and approval reason separately from the planner. Identical execution request/plan/approver/reason replay returns the immutable receipt,including after a later resume;it reports historical success without scanning again. Changed reason/scope with the same request is refused. Another request cannot overwrite an already-verified gap. Concurrent duplicates return one receipt. Missing/changed receipts or incomplete links refuse instead of recreating empty history. The first release creates metadata directly,without ALTER/migration support for old development candidates. Assess persistent state/data before resetting a test environment;copying only a cursor is invalid. See the first-release baseline. Operations and status GAP VERIFY PLAN persists review scope, GAP VERIFY EXECUTE approves its hash and GAP VERIFY CANCEL uses reserved cancellation admission. Cancellation can race commit and must be resolved from the original receipt rather than labelled rolled back. Control/Owner audit retains request,plan and result hashes. Existing revocation,revision,configuration and generation gates remain effective. hasGaps retains SKIP history while openGapCount / verifiedGapCount distinguish unresolved and verified records. Counts use a1001-row window and become lower bounds when gapCountLimited is true. If no unresolved row is seen in a limited window, hasOpenGaps=null rather than false. Paged gaps expose OPEN/VERIFIED AT COMMON CUT and receipt references without replacing SKIPPED. Verification changes neither ACK,business rows nor running state. Remaining work Real-CDC cross-entry acceptance passes27 checks per PG/MySQL control store with a PostgreSQL17 business verification target and a healthy MySQL8.4 peer. Other SQL,analytical and messaging protocols remain unverified. Before-image compensation,typed manual correction and other target protocols remain tracked by RC-06/07/10. Incremental progress uses one journal snapshot. Safe coverage includes explicit SKIP;the contiguous non-skipped prefix stops before the first historical skip even after verification. Indexed first-gap lookups avoid scanning payload history. SQL commit,broker receipt and materializer acknowledgment have distinct labels. Displayed sequences are exact decimal strings;baseline snapshot completion is separate.

title: 缺口核验：共同校验点与原子记录
text: 缺口核验：共同校验点与原子记录 English · 任务 · RC-08 DONE · 限定SQL档案 / bounded SQL profile 计划、管理员API/UI、跨节点审批与取消已接入，原生PG/MySQL各58项合同及103项DOM检查通过；PG/MySQL控制库各27项真实同步链路检查通过，RC-08限定SQL档案已完成。操作步骤和FAQ见核验手册。 审阅范围 核验计划固定一个目标、配置摘要、日志代次、源身份、共同校验点、已封存报告及源数据摘要，最多包含100条已有缺口和1000张相关表。每条缺口必须有完整事务计划与原生执行凭据；涉及表的历史 schema 版本必须与共同点一致。不同源、目标、代次、schema、坐标或不完整/存在差异的报告拒绝生成计划。计划仅包含元数据，不包含业务行值。 历史报告 MATCH 只允许形成审阅计划，不能直接消除缺口。执行时必须重新扫描目标上所有受影响表，使用有界磁盘排序计算行数和内容摘要，与封存的源数据比较；只核对行数或只核对跳过事务的行都不充分。差异、超时、原生断点变化或源暂停围栏变化都不写入核验成功记录。 并发与持久化 执行持有源日志任务行锁，从读取原缺口、扫描目标，到提交核验凭据始终不释放。恢复运行、Worker所有权变更以及同步服务的修复写入必须取得同一围栏。旧Worker另受目标原生epoch与共同点约束。各表不需要同时驻留内存。 本机制要求目标业务数据仅由同步服务写入；外部应用或管理员的直接写入不在此围栏内。未来手工补数据入口也必须取得同一围栏，不能绕过它。核验针对封存的历史源共同点，不宣称源当前时刻与目标相等。 源日志增加 rm3 gap verification plan 保存不可改写的审阅计划，增加 rm3 gap verification 保存成功凭据，并在 rm3 gap 保存核验ID与凭据摘要。一次源数据库事务同时写入凭据和全部选定缺口关联；任一步失败全部回滚。保留原始SKIP计划、回执、缺口和报告，不执行目标业务DML，不修改ACK，不恢复运行。 记录状态为 VERIFIED AT COMMON CUT ，凭据包含原审阅计划、共同点、核验时间、确认人、确认原因与执行请求ID；计划的创建人与确认人分别记录。相同执行请求、计划、确认人与原因重放返回原凭据；即使任务随后恢复运行，也只返回历史结果，不重新核验。相同请求修改原因或范围拒绝；已核验缺口不能用另一个请求覆盖。重复并发请求应得到同一凭据。凭据丢失、内容变更或关联不完整必须拒绝，不能静默创建空历史。 首版直接创建所需元数据结构，不增加旧开发候选的ALTER/迁移兼容。需要升级测试环境时先核对数据和持久状态，不能只复制游标。参见首版基线。 操作与状态 GAP VERIFY PLAN 持久生成计划， GAP VERIFY EXECUTE 按已批准摘要执行， GAP VERIFY CANCEL 通过预留的取消通道中断任务。取消结果必须读取原凭据核对；取消与提交可能竞争，不能直接显示为“已回滚”。控制和Owner审计保留原请求、计划及结果摘要；权限撤销、修订、配置/代次变化仍受现有准入检查。 hasGaps 继续表示原始SKIP历史， openGapCount 与 verifiedGapCount 区分未核验和已有共同点凭据的记录。统计窗口最多1001条， gapCountLimited 时数量是下界；没有在窗口发现未核验项时， hasOpenGaps=null 而非false。缺口分页显示OPEN/VERIFIED AT COMMON CUT及凭据引用，不覆盖原SKIPPED结果。核验成功不改变ACK、业务表或运行状态。 尚未完成 PG/MySQL控制库跨入口闭环各27项已通过，业务核验目标为PostgreSQL17，另有MySQL8.4健康订阅；原生PG/MySQL之外的SQL、分析库和消息目标仍未扩展核验协议。失败事务补偿、类型化手工补数据及其他目标协议仍由RC-06/07/10继续追踪。 增量水位以同一日志快照计算：安全覆盖包含显式SKIP；连续未跳过前缀止于首个历史SKIP之前，核验成功也不改写它。每目标按主键索引读取第一条历史缺口，不扫描全部缺口负载。SQL提交、Broker接收、物化确认分别标注；所有用于界面显示的序号使用十进制字符串。快照完成度独立展示。

title: Global control design
text: CP-02/03: global task authority and durable commands Contract for the next implementation, not accepted capability. Build on shared identity/audit/registry and preserve standalone APIs. Shared SQL owns unique task IDs, encrypted immutable configuration versions, control revisions, desired state, operations/receipts and owner bindings. Local directories are Worker/log/report projections. Bind authenticated encryption to cluster/store/task/version and protect its key from Worker environments. Import preserves pipeline identity/positions; duplicate IDs/resource conflicts require review without clearing targets or renaming pipelines automatically. Distinguish accepted configuration from owner-applied configuration. Every endpoint authorizes against shared identity/task grants and atomically records revision/request-ID checked intent and command.202 means durable acceptance. Duplicate requests return one operation; changed payload/identity reuse is rejected. Agents persist dispatch request IDs and original local revisions before calling TaskService, then replay identical arguments/receipts after restart rather than guessing that a lost reply meant no execution. Route create/check/start/stop/pause/resume/target retry/validation/repair/cancellation. Serialize conflicting changes; cancellation can bypass the maintenance operation it cancels. Distinguish pending/running/success/refusal/failure/unknown. Offline-owner STOP is not confirmed stopped. Initially pin owner node and data-directory identity. Reusing a nodeId with different data cannot silently take over. Expired observations stay UNKNOWN/STALE with timestamps while intent/queues persist. Automatic cross-node failover/drain/scheduling and controller/Worker lifecycle separation remain CP-04/07. Provide filtered/keyset-paged global tasks/totals/owners/revisions/observations/results. Cross-endpoint configuration masking uses verifiable scoped secret references. Owner-specific preview/raw differences/plans use typed expiring authenticated-encrypted SQL requests/replies with current authorization and node-epoch checks; production SQL transport uses TLS. Never trust client-supplied actor/owner or expose secret values. Keep desired/active versions, old active configuration on failure and reviewable rejected proposals. Owner-local reports cannot migrate by moving cursors; offline reads refuse explicitly while durable async commands may wait. Acceptance: A creates for B; both see one revision; A controls B with actual process/SQL evidence; duplicate/revision/permission/cancel/lost-reply/restart cases avoid duplicate execution; configuration/history/secret references work across endpoints; offline state/STOP remain unknown/waiting; store/key/directory mismatch refusal, paging/capacity/state migration and bilingual runbooks. These results do not close automatic execution failover CP-04/07. Storage and dispatch details (not yet integrated/accepted) A protected independent random32-byte master key derives separate keys bound to cluster/store identity. AES-GCM random nonces and task/version AAD reject substitution; keyed configuration/request digests avoid enumerable password hashes. Reconstruct actor roles from shared IAM. Missing keys/authority, identity mismatches and incomplete catalogs never seed a replacement. SQL applies both node/task grants, counts and bounded pagination. Non-administrators receive public metadata; ADMIN configuration responses remain redacted. Global task quota differs from local task/worker capacity. External immutable restore detection remains LG-09. Use typed encrypted, expiring requests/replies in shared SQL for owner-only previews/reports; production SQL transport uses TLS. Bind replies to cluster/store/task/request/owner epoch, cap and promptly expire sensitive payloads, and never trust browser-supplied actor roles. Separate waiting, dispatched, locally persisted, executing and terminal states. Persist original local revision/request/body digest before dispatch; lost replies reconcile original receipts/operations rather than resubmitting a fresh revision. Cancellation bypasses the maintenance queue it must interrupt. A202 is durable acceptance, not a committed destination transaction. Owner node plus private directory identity pins execution. Control epochs do not fence existing Workers or replace native journal/target guards. Pod deletion, lost contact or lease expiry does not prove a Worker stopped; cross-node execution takeover remains CP-04/07. Owner implementation progress (global entry not exposed) AgentDirectory binds stable nodeId, private directory UUID and current registration lease using task-store-derived HMACs. Initialization audit receipts and authenticated root counts detect missing/reset state. Wrong directories, expired leases and old incarnations cannot claim commands. Admission and claim validate leases in SQL transactions, locking IAM, task authority, node lease, agent root, then command root. This does not authorize automatic Worker failover. DurableCommands persists PENDING, DISPATCHED, ACCEPTED, UNKNOWN and terminal states. Before local invocation it seals the exact original local TaskRequest/revision. OwnerExecution invokes LocalTaskPlane and reconciles actual TaskService receipts/operations; local acceptance is not execution success. Lost replies/reopen reuse the original request. Missing evidence plus changed local revision remains UNKNOWN. TASK BUSY/OPERATION PENDING wait without replacing revisions/request IDs. Outstanding local receipts are protected from ordinary500-entry pruning while the owner is active. Global mode must restore every outstanding pin before exposing local mutation APIs. These remain internal primitives: CP-02/03 do not close until public global routing and acceptance exist. Cancellation has a parent and reserved capacity. An undispatched parent is atomically CANCELLED; an uncertain dispatched parent is reconciled first; actual cancellation is dispatched after parent ACCEPTED. Service completion can record committed outcomes after actor revocation, while new execution rechecks shared identity revision and task/node grants. Queries and observations (runtime integration open) OwnerQueries uses an expiring encrypted SQL mailbox and rejects mutations/LIST. It checks identity before execution, publication and delivery and binds owner/directory/epoch. Limits are512KiB requests,1MiB responses and1–60second expiry; expired rows release capacity. PostgreSQL/MySQL native checks passed. GlobalTaskViews publishes bounded authenticated observations and returns UNKNOWN for offline/new-epoch/stale owners; original metric observedAt is retained separately from ownerObservedAt. GlobalTaskPlane has internal cross-entry create/owner lifecycle/grant/offline STOP tests. Configuration/history/restore, startup migration, public HTTP/UI and complete business-chain acceptance remain open; CP-02/03 stay incomplete. Operations and FAQ. Public runtime increment, 2026-11-17 The opt-in sharedTasks profile now wires public HTTP/UI, configuration/history, owner queries, encrypted observations and fixed-owner commands. Startup restores receipt protections, verifies active configuration and scans all outstanding STOP/PAUSE pages before allowing Workers to restore RUNNING intent. Local-busy operations may complete without starting a Worker ahead of the stop. Invalidated authorization releases the block; uncertain evidence does not. Legacy local-task import is refused rather than silently migrated. CP-02/03 remain PARTIAL pending complete business, fault and migration acceptance. See the operations guide for current activation and limits.

title: 全局控制设计
text: CP-02/03：全局任务权威与持久命令合同 此合同指导下一阶段实现，尚未验收。依赖已验证的共享身份、审计和节点目录；保留单机接口。 权威和迁移 共享SQL保存全局唯一taskId、配置版本/密文、控制修订、期望状态、操作/幂等回执及owner绑定。独立本地目录继续保存Worker文件、日志和本地报告，作为执行投影；API不把本机controller.json当全局任务清单。配置密文采用带版本与taskId/cluster/store绑定的认证加密；密钥通过受保护配置提供并禁止下发任务进程，数据库不保存明文主密钥。 全局控制显式启用并提升集群协议，正常停止旧成员后切换，拒绝仍提供本地任务权威的成员加入。导入旧任务时保留pipeline身份、已有断点和owner数据目录身份；重复taskId/目标资源冲突拒绝并要求审阅，不自动清空目标或改pipelineId。所有节点读取同一修订与配置历史。新配置“已接受”和owner“已应用”分开表达。 命令与执行 任一入口校验共享身份、任务授权、期望修订和全局请求ID，在同一事务记录命令与控制意图。202只表示持久接受。重复请求返回同一操作；不同正文/身份复用ID拒绝。Agent按owner/代次读取队列，先持久记录本机派发请求ID和原本机修订，再调用现有TaskService，重启后复用相同参数和本机回执；不以读取到新修订后重新发一遍来猜测上次未执行。 支持创建/检查/启停/暂停/恢复/目标重试/校验/修复及取消；一个任务的冲突修改串行。取消必须能够旁路被取消的维护任务等待队列，保留原有中断/回执规则。操作状态区分PENDING、执行中、成功、拒绝、失败和UNKNOWN。离线owner的STOP不能报告已经停止。 首阶段owner固定，记录稳定节点ID和私有数据目录身份；不同目录重用nodeId不能自动接管。观察过期时显示UNKNOWN/STALE及采集时间，保留控制意图和队列。自动跨节点接管、排空/调度、控制与Worker进程解耦需CP-04/07单独协议/测试；本阶段不借租约过期声称已确认旧Worker停机。 查询、配置与界面 任务页按节点/任务/状态过滤并游标分页，展示全局总数、owner、控制修订、最近观察与操作结果。全局配置编辑使用跨入口可验证的保密字段引用；服务端只返回掩码/引用，不返回明文密钥。涉及owner文件/连接的预览、原始差异和计划读取，使用共享SQL中的有期限、认证加密查询/响应通道，绑定集群、存储身份、任务、请求和节点代次；生产SQL连接使用TLS。避免把浏览器身份或业务值放进节点URL。只执行固定类型查询，敏感响应限额并短期清理，不信任浏览器传入的actor/owner。 配置变更保存desired/active版本及应用结果；失败保留旧有效配置和可审阅的新提案。报告/计划仍在owner目录时标记数据可达性，不能只移动游标。纯查询/预览owner离线会明确拒绝，持久异步控制可保持等待。所有用户写请求继续使用Origin/CSRF及当前共享权限，不因转发绕过检查。 验收 两个独立目录/入口：A创建给B，双方全局修订一致；A控制B检查/启停/校验/修复，实际进程/SQL行为可核验；重复/修订/授权/取消、丢失回复和owner重开恢复不双执行；配置/历史/保密字段可跨入口操作；节点掉线显示未知，离线停止命令保持等待；集群存储/密钥/数据目录身份不匹配拒绝；分页和容量预算；新旧状态迁移及双语场景/FAQ。CP-04/07的自动执行接管不会因这些用例通过而关闭。 存储与派发细则（待接入/验收） 配置密钥是独立的32字节随机主密钥，通过保护的环境引用/文件提供。按集群及存储身份派生不同用途密钥；AES-GCM随机nonce与任务/版本AAD阻止内容被换到其他任务。SQL配置/请求摘要使用HMAC，避免用可枚举的明文密码摘要。账号权限先从共享目录重建，不能仅信任传入角色字段。主密钥丢失、身份不匹配、缺失权威或不完整目录不能自动创建替代状态。 任务列表在SQL中应用节点与任务授权过滤、统计和有界分页；普通账号只读取公共概况，配置编辑仍需ADMIN且响应继续掩码。根计数/任务元数据校验保护意外删除与替换；协调备份回退的外部不可变检测仍属LG-09。全局任务数量与单节点任务/运行容量分别配置。 派发状态区分等待、已派发、本机已持久接受、操作执行中和终态。Agent在本机持久保存原请求ID、原本机修订及正文摘要后派发；返回丢失时先恢复本机回执/原操作，不用新修订重发。任务队列的冲突意图串行；取消拥有独立优先通道，不能被正在等待取消的校验/修复占住。目标已提交但本机/全局状态回复丢失依照原生事务凭据恢复，不把一次202作为落库成功。 固定owner节点加私有目录身份共同决定执行归属；数据库租约和节点代次只保护控制命令派发，不能代替Worker/journal/目标原生隔离。仅删除Pod、失联或心跳过期不证明旧Worker已经停止。跨节点执行接管必须另行验证CP-04/07。 执行端实现进展（可选固定owner公开入口） AgentDirectory将稳定nodeId绑定私有目录UUID和当前注册租约，使用共享任务存储派生的HMAC验证元数据。目录与审计初始化回执、根计数共同检查；缺失目录/根、替换目录、过期租约和旧incarnation都不能重新获得派发权限。租约检查与命令认领同一个SQL事务；锁序为IAM、任务权威、节点租约、Agent根、命令根。此绑定不是自动Worker接管协议。 DurableCommands保存PENDING、DISPATCHED、ACCEPTED、UNKNOWN及终态。首次派发前将原本机TaskRequest（包括本机修订）认证加密持久化。OwnerExecution复用这个请求调用LocalTaskPlane，查询实际TaskService回执/操作，不能把本机接受当作执行完成。全局回复丢失或控制器重开后先查原回执；缺少证据且修订已变化时保留UNKNOWN。暂时TASK BUSY/OPERATION PENDING继续等待，不更换修订或重新生成请求。 未确认的本机请求回执在执行端活动期间免于普通500条回收；启用全局入口时必须在开放API/本地修改前恢复所有活动请求保护。现已接入可选共享任务运行时；启动恢复先保护回执、验证配置，再分页识别待处理STOP/PAUSE，防止先恢复旧RUNNING。旧任务导入和完整验收仍未完成，因此CP-02/03保持PARTIAL。 取消命令有父请求与预留容量。父任务未派发时原子标记父CANCELLED及取消成功；父已派发但本机是否接受不明时，先恢复父回执；仅在父ACCEPTED后派发实际取消。完成后的真实执行结果由服务身份登记，即使原操作者的权限已撤销；尚未执行的新命令须重验共享账号修订与节点/任务授权。 查询和观察实现（已接入可选运行时） OwnerQueries使用有期限的SQL加密信箱，禁止修改/LIST。执行前、结果发布和读取时检查当前身份，绑定owner目录/代次；请求512KiB、响应1MiB，有效期1至60秒，过期删除释放容量。原生PG/MySQL均已验证。GlobalTaskViews以认证密文发布有界任务观察，离线/新代次/过期返回UNKNOWN，不沿用旧健康状态；保留本机指标observedAt，另给出ownerObservedAt。GlobalTaskPlane已通过跨入口创建、实际owner启停、按节点/任务授权、失联STOP等待等内部测试。配置编辑/历史恢复及公开HTTP/界面现已接入；旧任务启动迁移和完整真实业务/故障矩阵仍缺，不能关闭CP-02/03。 Operations and FAQ.

title: RC-03 / RC-08: transaction skipping and durable gaps
text: RC-03 / RC-08: transaction skipping and durable gaps Status:bounded skip is implemented. Historical binary probes and automatic control-mode migration are removed;current consistency boundaries remain. The first profile uses transactional PostgreSQL/MySQL destinations with the original Agent/journal directory. Pause the whole task,confirm native fencing,and retain fresh complete raw/normalized evidence. Skip only the selected subscriber's next complete transaction. Preserve source GTID/original content and other subscribers' delivery semantics. RC-05 comparison is mandatory. Proven commits use acknowledgment reconciliation. Diverged checkpoints/content,missing normalization/history or changed epoch/error generations refuse execution. An unadvanced checkpoint alone does not prove absent business data. Capture/decode failures cannot masquerade as destination apply failures. A target-local transaction must commit an explicit SKIP receipt,original projected transaction identity and native safe progress together. Journal-side plans,gap records and ACK recovery must survive uncertain native commit responses. There is no common local transaction across systems:retain evidence/plan first,replay each commit boundary,and recover journal gaps/ACK from the native SKIP receipt. Never acknowledge before a proven native commit or mislabel SKIPPED as APPLIED. Bind operation ID,evidence,destination,reason and actor;conflicting retries refuse. Keep both pauses and advance the error generation. SKIP must never enter ordinary APPLY acknowledgment. Whole-task pause and epoch fencing revoke in-flight Workers;current fanout verifies explicit SKIP receipts against source gaps. The first release retains no old-binary compatibility probes or prerelease-state migrations. Namespace mode is fixed and mismatches refuse. The durable gap binds operation/evidence/source identity and range,destination/objects,actor/reason/time,native receipt,recovery stage and configuration/generation. The UI must explicitly show skipped data and pending recovery,never lossless catch-up. Preserve evidence and support task/destination gap queries. Acceptance covers whole multi-table transactions,mappings,empty projections/BARRIER and keyless identities;uncommitted/proven-committed/diverged cases;crashes before/after native commit and journal gap/ACK commit;competing administrators,stale generations,revoked authority,stale Worker fencing;and continued source ordering for unaffected destinations with visible durable gaps and divergence. Initial implementation decisions Create the control namespace directly in the configured mode,with consistent shared access/tasks and review/confirmation/skip capabilities. Existing namespace modes cannot migrate. The current program transitions the journal from normal state3 to recovery-ledger state4 atomically with its first PREPARED plan,after whole-task pause/epoch fencing. This is a runtime state transition,not a prerelease upgrade promise. Add native SKIP-only checkpoint markers without changing ordinary APPLY JSON. New fanout refuses normal ACK for a journal-ahead SKIP,and validates already-acknowledged markers against durable gaps. Block task/affected-target resume while a PREPARED plan exists. A format4 journal missing plan/gap tables refuses rather than creating empty history. Preserve completed receipts/gaps/evidence for idempotent replay after progress/GC. Reject conflicting requests,ambiguous phases,empty projections,nontransactional affected tables,incomplete snapshots,changed shape/ownership and unsupported trigger/external dependencies.

title: RC-03 / RC-08：事务跳过与缺口记录设计
text: RC-03 / RC-08：事务跳过与缺口记录设计 状态：首批事务跳过已实现；本文保留状态与一致性边界，开发版本二进制兼容探针及控制模式自动迁移已移除。 边界 首个档案沿用事务型 PostgreSQL/MySQL 目标及原 Agent/日志目录。要求暂停整个任务、原生目标围栏已完成、保留新的完整原始/规范化事务证据。只允许跳过选定订阅的下一完整事务，不修改源 GTID，不删除原日志内容，不影响其他订阅应处理的源事件。 必须先使用 RC-05 核对：已提交的目标事务走确认流程；原生断点越界、内容不一致、历史模式或规范化内容缺失、epoch/错误版本变化均拒绝。断点未前进本身不能证明目标业务数据不存在。需要核对原生目标写入协议和完整事务边界，不能把采集/解码故障假装成目标应用失败。 执行与崩溃恢复 目标本地事务同时保存 SKIP 回执、原始事务投影身份及原生安全进度，明确标记结果为 SKIPPED，不能伪造 APPLIED。日志侧保存可恢复的操作计划和持久缺口记录；原生提交成功但日志确认丢失时，必须按原生 SKIP 回执恢复缺口和 ACK。跨系统没有一个共同本地事务，因此每个提交边界均需可重放，不能声称存在跨系统原子提交。 同一操作 ID、证据摘要、目标、原因和操作人必须幂等；参数不同拒绝。先保留原证据和计划，再改变原生断点。目标未能提交 SKIP 时，日志不能提前确认。保持整个任务和目标暂停，并推进目标错误版本，使旧恢复请求失效。 当前执行围栏 SKIP不能进入普通APPLY确认路径。全任务暂停并推进epoch，撤销已在途Worker；当前Fanout必须核对明确的SKIP回执与源缺口。首版不保留旧二进制兼容探针或旧开发状态迁移，控制命名空间模式固定，不匹配立即拒绝。 缺口与界面 缺口至少包含：操作ID、证据ID/摘要、源身份和事务范围、目标/表范围、原因、操作人、确认时间、原生回执、恢复阶段及关联配置/世代。界面必须显示“已跳过、数据存在缺口”，不能显示为无损追平。支持按任务/目标查询，原生提交尚未完成日志确认时显示待恢复；不能删除证据来隐藏缺口。 必要验收 - 完整跨表事务、目标数据库映射、空投影/BARRIER及无主键标识边界。 - 真正未提交、已提交、原生序号/摘要/epoch不符三类情况，禁止误跳。 - 目标提交前、提交后响应丢失、日志缺口/ACK提交前后的进程强杀与原操作重试。 - 两个管理员竞争、旧错误版本、权限撤销、旧 Worker 恢复及当前执行围栏。 - 其他目标仍按原源顺序处理；界面能查到原证据和持久缺口；恢复后明确显示存在数据差异。 首个实现决策 - 控制面按首次配置直接建立所需模式；启用跳过时一致配置共享访问、共享任务及审阅/确认/跳过能力。不支持已有命名空间模式迁移。 - 数据日志第一次准备跳过时由正常状态3进入含恢复台账的状态4，与PREPARED计划一起提交；之前先整体暂停并完成epoch围栏。这是当前程序的状态转换，不是开发版本升级承诺。 - 原生断点新增仅 SKIP 时非空的标记与回执摘要，普通 APPLY 不改变旧断点的JSON表示。新 Fanout 遇到领先ACK的SKIP必须拒绝普通确认；已经确认的SKIP断点必须能匹配源侧缺口。 - 存在 PREPARED 计划时，恢复任务和恢复相关目标必须拒绝，直到原操作恢复完成或经过受控取消。这样目标已提交/日志未提交时不会被自动循环伪装成APPLIED。 - 对已有格式4日志，计划/缺口表丢失必须拒绝，不能自动建空表掩盖历史；正常状态3首次准备恢复只允许创建专用元数据。 - 回执、缺口和原证据保留，当前目标断点推进后仍能按原操作ID重试读取结果；不同参数或另一操作竞争同一事务必须拒绝。 - 首档目标检查受影响表的事务能力、快照完成、结构/所有权和已知依赖，拒绝不明确的触发器/外部副作用。没有完整目标投影或不是明确 TARGET APPLY 故障时不提供跳过。

title: Session design
text: SE-01/02/03/05: single-controller session design 中文 · Specification · Operations This implementation closes reload recovery, single-controller session lifecycle, protected transport and existing API compatibility. SE-04 and the CP shared control authority remain unfinished; MemoryStore is not shared control storage. Restart requires sign-in again without changing task/account/audit storage formats. State and interfaces BrowserSessions.Store defines insert/find/touch/remove/close. The bounded in-memory implementation purges expired entries. Keys are SHA256 digests of256-bit random session IDs; values contain principal/directory revision, random CSRF value, last activity and absolute expiry. Raw session IDs and API tokens are not retained. Both session IDs and CSRF values use32-byte SecureRandom and unpadded URL-safe Base64. Every request checks the candidate session against the current TaskService account directory: user exists, is enabled and has the same directory revision. Any directory mutation strictly revokes all older sessions. Task commit retains existing currentActor revision checks. Explicit Bearer never falls back to cookies; two valid but different identities are rejected. Audit stores identity/outcome without authentication material. A future shared backend must provide atomic bounded creation, expiry/touch/revocation and consistent authorization checks integrated with shared accounts, audit and command authority. Replacing the interface with another Map or mounting a shared directory cannot close SE-04. The complete shared control-state contract and migration protocol remain CP-02 work; empty interfaces are not counted as implementation. HTTP and page contract POST /api/session requires Bearer, GET /api/session accepts Bearer or cookies, and POST /api/session/logout requires cookies. Production defaults use the Host prefix, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/ and no Domain. Explicit local HTTP uses a different cookie name. Proxy publicOrigin is the exact external origin; forwarded headers are not trusted. Cookie mutations require both Origin and CSRF checks. The proxy terminates production TLS. Startup restores the server session and grants without reading a saved token; invalid sessions show sign-in. Language preference is the only persistent Web Storage value. API requests carry a page-session generation so late responses cannot mutate a newer identity. Refresh locks also use generations, preventing an old refresh from blocking a new login. Sign-in, sign-out and reauthentication after self-token rotation use one authentication queue. Sign-out clears UI state immediately, waits behind outstanding login, obtains the current CSRF credential and revokes that cookie, including a delayed login result. BroadcastChannel sends only a sign-out signal; recipients clear state and queue revocation without broadcasting secrets. Server sign-out failures show bilingual retry guidance. A confirmed self-token rotation may exchange the newly saved token for a completely new session; the previous session remains invalid. Acceptance scope - Eight real HTTP contract tests cover restoration, Origin/CSRF refusal, roles, identity conflicts, no fallback, directory-wide revocation, rotation/disable/grant changes, self-rotation, disabled sessions, restart invalidation, expiry/capacity and configuration validation. - Those eight tests run against the same candidate JAR on Java8/11/17/21/25. This is a session profile, not the full source/target/JDK matrix. - A TLS proxy and real CookieJar verify HTTPS cookies, withholding Secure credentials on HTTP, CSRF/Origin refusal, replay refusal after logout, Bearer compatibility and absence of plaintext credentials in state. - DOM coverage includes reload/new pages, sign-out, multiple tabs, late401/login/refresh, failed server sign-out and self-token rotation, preserving editor/audit/validation/repair tests. - Artifact checks, root and artifact-first tests, Helm/native parity and the updated Docker preview are archived separately. Full-browser visual/accessibility, live Kubernetes/CSI, shared controllers/sessions, OIDC and human-inactivity detection remain outside this acceptance. Historical gaps stay open.

title: 会话设计
text: SE-01/02/03/05：单控制节点会话设计 English · 需求 · 操作手册 本实现关闭浏览器刷新保持、单控制器会话生命周期、安全传输和现有 API 兼容四项。SE-04 共享会话与 CP 全局控制权威状态继续保留为未完成；MemoryStore 不是共享控制存储。控制器重启要求重新登录，不修改任务、账号或审计存储格式。 状态与接口 BrowserSessions.Store 定义 insert/find/touch/remove/close；当前实现为带最大容量、过期清理的内存映射。键为256位随机会话 ID 的 SHA256；值为身份快照、目录修订、CSRF 随机值、最后访问时间与绝对期限。不保留原始会话 ID 或 API 令牌。Cookie ID 和 CSRF 各使用32字节 SecureRandom、URL-safe Base64 无填充。 每次请求先恢复候选会话，再在 TaskService 当前账号目录下核验用户存在、可用且目录修订一致。任何目录修改严格撤销全部旧会话；任务提交继续经过已有 currentActor 版本校验。显式 Bearer 不回退 Cookie，双有效身份不一致拒绝；审计继续保存认证身份与结果，不保存认证材料。 以后共享后端必须实现原子有界创建、到期/触摸/撤销和强一致权限重验，同时与共享账号、审计及节点命令权威状态整合。仅把此接口换成某个 Map 或挂载共享文件夹不能关闭 SE-04。共享控制状态完整接口/迁移协议留到 CP-02 设计，不以空壳接口计为实现。 HTTP 与页面合同 POST /api/session 仅接受 Bearer，GET /api/session 支持 Bearer 或 Cookie，POST /api/session/logout 只接受 Cookie。默认生产 Cookie 使用 Host 前缀、Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict、Path=/、不设置 Domain；本地 HTTP 显式使用不同 Cookie 名。反向代理 publicOrigin 为精确外部 Origin，程序不信任 forwarded 头；Cookie 写请求必须同时通过 Origin/CSRF 检查。生产 TLS 由代理终止。 页面启动不读保存的令牌：先恢复服务器会话和权限，失效再显示登录框。语言是唯一持久 Web Storage 数据。每个 API 请求记录页面会话代次，迟到响应不能改写新会话；状态刷新锁也以代次隔离，旧刷新不会阻塞新登录。 登录、退出和自身令牌轮换后的重新认证经同一认证队列执行。退出立即清界面，再等待已发登录结束，取当前 CSRF 并撤销其 Cookie；这包括晚到登录响应。BroadcastChannel 只广播退出信号，接收方同样清理并排队撤销，不广播认证材料。服务端退出失败显示可重试的双语提示。自身令牌轮换成功后可以用刚确认保存的新令牌自动换取全新会话；旧会话仍失效。 验收边界 - 服务端8项真实 HTTP 合同测试：刷新恢复、Origin/CSRF 拒绝、角色约束、身份冲突、不回退、全目录撤销、轮换/停用/授权变化、自身轮换、关闭会话功能、控制器重启失效、期限/容量与配置校验。 - 同一候选 JAR 上 Java8/11/17/21/25 各运行上述8项；这是会话专项，不能替代全源/目标/JDK矩阵。 - TLS 代理 + 实际 CookieJar：HTTPS 发送 Cookie、HTTP 不发送 Secure 凭证、CSRF/Origin 拒绝、退出后旧 Cookie 不可重放、Bearer 兼容、状态中无明文会话/令牌。 - DOM 覆盖刷新/新页面、退出、跨标签页、迟到401/登录/刷新、服务端退出失败、自身令牌轮换；保留原编辑器/审计/校验/修复测试。 - 制品门禁、根构建及制品优先应用测试、Helm/原生清单一致性和更新后的 Docker 预览另行归档。 真实浏览器视觉/可访问性、真实 Kubernetes/CSI、多控制实例/共享会话、OIDC及人机空闲检测仍未验收。不会用本轮测试关闭这些历史欠项。

title: Shared access design
text: SE-04 / CP-05: shared identity, sessions and audit 中文. This is an implementation contract; requirements stay open until acceptance. Explicit cluster.sharedAccess enables SQL account/session/audit authority while preserving default standalone/registry behavior. It does not turn local task pages into global control; CP-02/03 provide that separately. Bootstrap imports a verified managed-account snapshot or configured accounts. Bind a separate shared-store identity and cluster identity into an upgraded local state format. Old software/disabling shared authority must refuse fallback to stale local grants. Missing/changed store identity and conflicting directories fail startup; existing shared accounts are never overwritten by old bootstrap tokens. Keep pre-import local audit history and an import anchor without rewriting historical chains. Every authentication/grant/session check consults shared authority. Account mutation, directory-wide session revocation and account audit commit atomically with revision/request receipts. Session creation locks/checks the current account revision. Cookie IDs remain opaque/random; SQL retains only digests and minimal principal/CSRF/expiry data. Database time governs expiry and member policy settings must match. Closing one controller does not clear shared sessions. A login can resume at B after A restarts; logout/disable/rotation revoke old credentials everywhere. Bearer and Origin/CSRF rules remain. Shared audit uses a serialized sequence/hash chain and retention anchor. Retry the same event ID idempotently and reject payload collisions. Drain local durable outboxes only after shared confirmation. Preserve/export pre-import local history separately. Acceptance requires independent directories sharing SQL: A-login/B-restore, kill-A/B-continuity, logout/rotation/grant revocation across nodes/restart, no local fallback during store failure, import/identity-loss/rollback refusal, concurrent account/session/audit and expiry/capacity/idempotency contracts, native PG/MySQL, UI and bilingual recovery docs. Full CP-05 also requires least-privilege task-secret distribution and cannot close based on shared accounts alone. SE-04 accepted; CP-05 remains partial. Evidence.

title: 共享访问设计
text: SE-04 / CP-05：共享身份、会话和审计合同 English。此合同的SE-04范围已验收，CP-05部分完成；见证据。 通过显式 cluster.sharedAccess 选项启用SQL共享账号权威、会话与审计。默认单机/目录档案不改变；该选项并不把本机任务页自动变为全局控制。全局任务与命令另由CP-02/03实现。 首次初始化可导入当前已验证的托管账号快照，或以部署账号引导共享目录。保存独立的共享存储身份，并在本机控制状态中持久绑定cluster/store身份，升级状态格式，旧程序或关闭共享选项时拒绝回退为旧本地授权。共享库缺失/身份变化/目录冲突拒绝启动；已存在共享目录不被启动配置中的旧令牌覆盖。迁移前备份本地状态和审计；原有历史保留在本地，并记录导入锚点，不伪造同一条历史链。 每次认证、权限重验、账号修改和会话恢复查询共享权威，不以本地缓存或黏性会话代替一致性。账号变更、全目录会话撤销和账号变更审计在同一SQL事务提交；保留修订、请求ID及回执检查。创建会话时锁定账号修订，拒绝已撤销的身份快照。 Cookie仍为不可读的随机会话ID；共享库只保存其摘要及最小身份/CSRF/期限数据。期限使用数据库时间；相同共享会话策略在所有成员核验，跨节点时钟差不延长权限。控制器关闭仅释放本地连接，不清空其他节点仍在使用的共享会话。节点重启、请求从A转到B可恢复；退出/停用/轮换后B拒绝旧会话。API Bearer、Origin/CSRF规则保留。 共享审计采用数据库锁定的序号/哈希链与保留锚点。HTTP及新任务审计按同一事件ID重试，不能因跨节点重试重复写或忽略不同载荷。原本机持久outbox在共享审计确认后才清理；故障时拒绝宣称已经完成。导入前本地历史保留并单独导出，不重写旧载荷。 验收：两个独立控制目录、共享SQL、A登录/B恢复；杀掉A后B继续认证；在B退出/轮换/改权限，A和重开节点拒绝旧凭据；共享存储中断不得回退到本地账号或内存会话；目录导入、存储身份丢失和旧程序回退拒绝；并发账号/会话/审计、期限/容量和幂等事务检查；真实PG/MySQL档案、UI与双语恢复说明。完整CP-05还包括任务密钥最小下发，不能只凭共享账号标为全部完成。

title: Implementation plan
text: Design boundaries,decisions and delivery order RM-SDD-001 · v0.9 · 2026-11-17 · IMPLEMENTING: transaction skip and gap recovery Spec · Tasks · Acceptance · 中文 Current authority: requirements.json,tasks and acceptance. 13 DONE,30 PARTIAL,5 NEW;35 open . RC-05 andRC-03passed bounded profiles;Bounded gap verification and compensation have passed. Bounded manual correction has passed. Distributed recovery jobs are next. Current baseline Maintain the current first-release specification and verification baseline. Superseded candidate inventories, permanent previews and old-binary upgrade procedures are removed. Accepted scope and limitations remain explicit; historical tests do not certify new changes. Request traceability User item SDD range Incomplete items --- --- --- 1 Unified cluster control CP-01–CP-07 5 2 Persistent login SE-01–SE-05 0 3 Skip and corrective data RC-01–RC-10 5 4 Source versions/PG/Oracle SO-01–SO-07 7 5 Five Java versions JV-01–JV-04 4 6 Complete docs DO-01–DO-05 5 Preserved previous scope LG-01–LG-10 10 Currentv0.9:48items total,13DONE,5NEW and30PARTIAL;35remain open. PARTIAL means foundations exist but the whole requirement is incomplete,not that accepted features must be rebuilt. Confirmed scope Unified multi-node management must control remote tasks from any entry,not just aggregate local pages. Login survives reload with effective logout/revocation. Reviewed manual skip/corrective data are required while automatic recovery remains no-skip by default. MySQL5.7/8.0/8.2/8.4,PostgreSQL and Oracle sources are committed scope rather than optional future placeholders. Java8/11/17/21/25 require real runtime evidence. Complete bilingual scenarios/FAQ and all earlier destination,mapping,optional-storage,deployment and migration requirements remain. Proposed cluster architecture Separate logical management entry,shared control authority,node agents/workers and source-journal/destination protocols. Control metadata,sessions and CDC journal are different concepts;they may share a suitable SQL instance in separate namespaces or use separate deployments. Standalone mode need not acquire an independent journal service. Global node/task IDs,revisions and grants come from authoritative cluster state. Agents execute durable typed/idempotent commands bound to owner generation;local ProcessBuilder is no longer the sole execution channel. Remote interfaces do not expose arbitrary host shells. Distinguish accepted,queued,executing,confirmed,rejected,failed and unknown outcomes;timeouts do not prove a stop. Stale owners and delayed commands are fenced. Report/plan/raw-event/secret locations need ownership and integrity references. Local-only logs/reports pin placement to a recoverable node/volume unless actual reachability is established;moving only a cursor is invalid. Standalone embedded state remains a profile;multiple controllers need verified shared authority/session semantics. Agent lifecycle is separated from console shutdown under an explicit continuation/pause policy. Candidate entities are Cluster,Node (incarnation/heartbeat/capabilities/resources),Task (source/targets/revision/owner),Command (request/grants/expectations/result),Session,RecoveryPlan and ConsistencyGap. Final schemas/backends/protocols are follow-up designs,not existing APIs. Proposed login persistence Preserve API tokens but exchange browser login for a revocable short-lived server session. Prefer a protected cookie inaccessible to page script with production HTTPS and CSRF/Origin checks rather than writing a long-lived administrator token to localStorage. OWASP session guidance. Restore session/grants before loading tasks;controllers share authority. Logout,disable,rotation and permission revocation invalidate appropriately. Bearer APIs remain compatible and identity conflict rules are explicit. Idle/absolute expiry,remembering across browser closure and OIDC are configurable policy decisions;this inventory does not invent a confirmed duration or mandatory two-person approval. Recovery semantics Action Meaning Progress/data boundary --- --- --- Retry Replay the original transaction Resolve uncertain commit before more writes Existing COMMON CUT repair Correct historical differences Remain paused;old report retains differences Pending failed-transaction compensation Restore initial affected identity state Preserve original event,occurrence IDs,PK moves and ordering;do not prematurely count source transaction as applied Pending manual patch Reviewed typed destination edits No implicit source writes;review before/after/counts and refuse drift/dependency violations Bounded destination skip Omit one complete known transaction for selected targets Native SKIP receipt plus gap ledger;coverage may advance while applied progress remains honest Pending capture-range quarantine/exclusion Separate plan before complete event formation Identify every affected subscriber and retain raw logs;unprovable boundaries are refused with log/valid-source/rebaseline recovery alternatives Replica-like operation is a UX/recovery requirement,not a command-copy requirement. MySQL differentiates GTID and non-GTID skipping:official guidance. Rivomesh needs its own audited heterogeneous receipt/gap protocol,not source empty-transaction injection,gtid executed editing or a universal sql replica skip counter wrapper. Committed destinations with lagging journal ACK must recover acknowledgment,not compensate or invent an unapplied skip. Destination skip scope is independent;capture exclusion may affect all relevant targets and must declare that scope. Analytical/queue adapters require their own verified protocol rather than SQL transaction promises. A proposed gap record links source/range,transaction/raw/normalized hashes,target scope,reason,actor/approval,original evidence,receipts and subsequent validation. Open,in-remediation,verified resolution and explicitly accepted loss are distinct;accepted loss is not equality. Final enums/transitions are pending design. Source and runtime profiles Source Existing scope Remaining --- --- --- MySQL5.7 Basic5.7.44 evidence Current V3 objects/recovery/HA/runtime profile MySQL8.0 Historical8.0.46 V2/HA Current V3/new recovery acceptance MySQL8.2 No dedicated complete evidence found New profile,compatibility differences and native tests MySQL8.4 Representative V3/recovery Broader auth/log/topology/target/JDK matrix PostgreSQL PLANNED source Snapshot/LSN/slot,transactions,promotion;PG sink support is unrelated Oracle PLANNED source Capture route/version/grants/distribution,SCN/redo/archive,types and recovery PG slot snapshot export binds baseline/stream position;recovery can resend events and needs dedup. Promotion depends on exact version and slot conditions:logical decoding,failover. Oracle identity/incarnation cannot be reduced to one SCN number:Oracle19 LogMiner fields. These are design references,not implemented source claims. Runtime evidence binds candidate SHA,actual JVM/architecture,driver,source profile,destination,journal,auth/TLS and workload. Each approved source profile crosses five JDKs for snapshot,CDC,restart and content checks. Four MySQL profiles plus one PG and one Oracle profile imply at least30source/JDK baseline combinations,not the total target,type,HA or security matrix. Show unrun,failed,experimental and unsupported separately. Proposed sequencing Milestone Work Exit --- --- --- M0 this change Requirements,gaps,tasks,acceptance,evidence baseline 48traceable IDs and documentation checks M1 Session and shared-state contracts;fix reload persistence SE-01/02/03 and standalone compatibility;storage abstraction remains extensible M2 Nodes,remote commands,grants/audit,control HA/session continuity Two-node control,partition/stale-owner/controller-failure acceptance M3 Failed inspection,gap ledger,SQL-first skip/compensation/patches Reviewed boundaries,refusals,receipt recovery,UI/docs;other adapters are not mislabeled supported M4 Four MySQL profiles and PG source Candidate/runtime/object/recovery gates per profile M5 Oracle and more vendor/storage/runtime/deployment profiles Native version/grants/data evidence with explicit PDB/RAC scope M6 Earlier backlog,cutover,live K8s,capacity/soak/release gates Function,migration,bilingual docs and unambiguous evidence per requirement The user subsequently authorized implementation;this ordering is not a delivery-date promise. Common session/source contracts may progress independently;not every phase must be strictly serial. Open details without reopening confirmed scope Control-store product/HA,agent enrollment/auth and standalone upgrade;session expiry/browser-closure/identity policy;exact initial PG versions/database-schema scope and slot failover;Oracle version/capture/CDB-PDB-RAC/storage/distribution;initial recovery profiles,large-event retention and safe capture-range exclusion;Linux architecture,liveK8s/CSI/vendor hardware and benchmark resources. These are profile/policy details,not reasons to ask again whether already-confirmed features are wanted. No universal TPS/RTO number is invented. Definition of done A requirement closes only with linked design/task/API/UI,positive/refusal/duplicate/crash tests,state/config migration,bilingual docs and the same candidate artifact evidence. Build success is not connector acceptance;static YAML is not liveK8s;DOM/HTTP is not visual/accessibility acceptance. This inventory does not mark48runtime requirements implemented.

title: 实施计划
text: 设计边界、决策和实施顺序 RM-SDD-001 · v0.9 · 2026-11-17 · 实施中：推进事务跳过与缺口 规格 · 任务 · 验收 · English 当前状态以 requirements.json、任务清单和验收清单为准： 13 DONE、30 PARTIAL、5 NEW，35 项未完成 。RC-05与RC-03限定档案已验收，缺口核验和事务补偿已通过限定档案。下一项为分布式恢复作业。 1. 当前基线 只维护当前首版规格与验证基线，不再保留逐候选版本的重复清单、常驻预览或旧二进制升级步骤。已验收能力的范围及限制仍保留，不将历史测试冒充当前改动的验证。 本次六项要求的追踪映射 用户项 SDD范围 未完成项数 --- --- --- 1 多节点统一控制 CP-01～CP-07 5 2 登录保持 SE-01～SE-05 0 3 跳过与补数据 RC-01～RC-10 5 4 源版本/PG/Oracle SO-01～SO-07 7 5 五个Java版本 JV-01～JV-04 4 6 完整文档 DO-01～DO-05 5 既有范围合并保留 LG-01～LG-10 10 共48项：13项DONE，余35项为5项NEW、30项PARTIAL。PARTIAL表示已有基础但本项整体未完成；不是把已验收功能删除重做。 2. 用户已明确的需求，不再当作可选项 1. 同一平台多节点统一管理，任一管理入口能看到并控制远端任务，不能只聚合几个本机界面。 2. 登录状态刷新后保持；退出、失效和权限撤销仍必须有效。 3. 遇到同步故障，有经审阅的人工跳过、补数据及重试路径；普通自动恢复继续默认不跳过。 4. 源端必须纳入 MySQL5.7/8.0/8.2/8.4、PostgreSQL、Oracle；PG/Oracle从“未来预留”升级为本次承诺范围。 5. Java8/11/17/21/25都要有实际运行证据，不能只看编译级别或镜像标签。 6. 完整中英文文档、场景和FAQ；既有多库显式映射、同源多目标、产品覆盖、可选日志、四类部署和信创改造目标继续保留。 3. 多节点设计提案 建议拆分统一管理入口、共享控制状态、节点Agent/Worker和源日志/目标应用协议。控制元数据、会话和源日志不是同一概念，可在合适SQL实例上分命名空间复用，也可独立部署；不强制所有单机部署新增独立日志服务。 - 统一入口 ：Web/API/CLI面向一个逻辑集群。节点ID、任务ID、任务修订和权限在集群范围有明确权威状态。 - Agent执行 ：控制器提交有类型、可去重、带代次的持久命令；当前owner或被授权Agent执行。控制器本机 ProcessBuilder 不再是唯一执行通道。远端接口只提供授权生命周期/任务操作，不提供任意主机Shell。 - 命令结果 ：区分已接受、排队、执行、确认、失败、拒绝、结果未知。超时或网络分区不能直接显示“已停止”；未知结果需用同一请求ID核对。 - 隔离 ：集群注册代次与任务租约/epoch联合验证。旧owner复活或命令延迟到达时拒绝写入，不能仅依赖心跳或副本数。 - 存储位置 ：计划、报告、原始事件和密钥使用带归属/校验的引用。若日志或报告仅本地存在，任务需绑定节点/可恢复卷，不能在其他节点只恢复一个游标就继续。 - HA边界 ：单机嵌入式配置继续存在；多控制实例需共享权威状态和会话，或经过验证的等效一致性方案。管理实例退出与Agent执行进程生命周期分离，具体继续/暂停策略写入部署档案。 候选逻辑实体：Cluster、Node（incarnation、心跳、能力、资源）、Task（源/目标、修订、owner代次）、Command（请求ID、权限、期望状态、执行回执）、Session、RecoveryPlan、ConsistencyGap。字段、后端和协议的最终详细设计仍待后续规格增量确认，不能把这些名称当成现有API。 4. 登录保持提案 保留已有API令牌能力，浏览器登录后换取可撤销的短期服务器会话；建议使用不暴露给页面脚本的受保护cookie，生产经HTTPS传输，配套CSRF/Origin防护。不能将长期管理员令牌写入localStorage来完成刷新保持。OWASP会话管理说明。 页面启动先恢复会话及权限，再加载任务；多实例请求共享会话权威状态。退出、账号停用、轮换和权限撤销应触发相应失效。CLI/API Bearer方式继续可用，身份冲突规则需明确。空闲/绝对期限、浏览器关闭后是否记住登录、是否接入OIDC属于策略配置；本次不擅自把某个时长或双人审批定为用户已确认要求。 5. 人工恢复边界 操作 语义 进度与数据约束 --- --- --- 重试 重新执行原事务 不改原事件；不确定提交先核对目标回执 共同校验点修复（已有） 在共同历史点修复差异 完成后仍暂停；历史报告不改写为MATCH 失败事务补偿（待做） 恢复受影响身份的事务前状态，再允许重放 保留原事务、无主键ROW ID、主键移动及重复变更顺序；补偿不提前算原事务成功 手工补数据（待做） 审阅的类型化目标数据补丁 默认只写目标；前后状态/行数可审阅；漂移、依赖和权限不符拒绝 目标事务跳过（限定档案已完成） 对指定目标不应用一整个已知事务 生成SKIP凭据和一致性缺口，安全覆盖进度可前进，但不得伪装为已应用 采集范围隔离/排除（待做） 针对采集/解码未完成处的独立缺口计划 影响全部相关订阅；必须证明范围边界、留存原日志；无法证明则拒绝并引导日志恢复/合格源/新基线 “类似MySQL从库操作”指操作体验和可恢复性，不是照搬数据库服务器命令。MySQL官方也区分GTID与非GTID的跳过方式，参见事务跳过。Rivomesh是异构同步服务，应使用自己的可审计回执和缺口协议，不向源库注入空事务、不直接修改源 gtid executed ，也不把 sql replica skip counter 当作跨产品通用实现。 目标已提交而日志ACK落后时，应恢复确认，不能把已经生效的数据再标记为“未应用跳过”。一个目标跳过不应隐式影响其他目标。采集层排除则可能影响全部相关目标，审批范围必须明确。消息队列/分析库按各自可验证协议实现，不承诺它们具备SQL本地跨表事务。 缺口建议记录：源身份/坐标范围、事务和原始/规范化摘要、目标范围、原因、操作者/批准、原事件位置、SKIP/补偿回执、后续对账和处置状态。OPEN、修复中、已验证修复、已明确接受丢失应区分；“接受丢失”不能显示成“完全一致”。最终枚举和状态迁移为待实施设计。 6. 源端及Java兼容性验收口径 源 现状 未完成要求 --- --- --- MySQL5.7 5.7.44基础链路证据 当前V3对象/恢复/HA及运行时档案补齐 MySQL8.0 8.0.46历史V2/HA等证据 当前发布V3和新增恢复能力补验 MySQL8.2 未发现专项完整证据 新增版本档案、实现差异和实测 MySQL8.4 代表性V3/恢复已验收 扩展认证、日志特性、拓扑、目标和JDK矩阵 PostgreSQL SOURCE目录为PLANNED 一致性快照/LSN/逻辑槽、事务和源切换；PG目标支持不算源支持 Oracle SOURCE目录为PLANNED 路线、版本、权限及分发条件；SCN/redo/归档、事务、类型及恢复 PG使用复制槽导出快照与流位置衔接；槽恢复可能重发，因此需去重。主备续传能力与确切版本及槽同步条件有关，不能泛化到全部版本。PG逻辑解码、PG故障切换。Oracle方案须区分源数据库及incarnation，不能只存一个数字SCN，见Oracle19 LogMiner会话字段。以上为设计依据，不是新增连接器已经实现。 Java矩阵必须绑定候选包SHA、实际JVM/架构、驱动、源版本/模式、目标、日志、权限/TLS与负载。每个批准的源档案至少与五JDK执行全量、增量、重启和内容验证。若首批为四条MySQL版本档案+一个PG档案+一个Oracle档案，最低为30个“源档案×JDK”基线组合；这不是所有目标、类型、HA和安全用例的总数。更细矩阵按已批准档案扩展，未跑/失败/实验/不支持状态必须分别展示。 7. 建议实施顺序，不是工期承诺 阶段 工作 退出条件 --- --- --- M0 当前轮 规格、差距、任务、验收与证据基线 48项ID/依赖/任务/验收可追踪，文档一致性检查通过 M1 会话与共享控制状态接口；先解决刷新保持 SE-01/02/03及单机兼容通过；共享后端接口不锁死本地会话 M2 节点注册、远端命令、权限/审计、控制HA和会话连续性 两节点同一入口控制、分区/旧owner/控制器故障测试通过 M3 失败事务检查、缺口台账、先SQL目标事务跳过及补偿/补数据 明确边界、拒绝不安全操作、凭据恢复、UI与文档闭环；其他目标不能伪标支持 M4 MySQL四版本档案与PG源 当前候选包与对应JDK/对象/恢复矩阵逐项通过 M5 Oracle源及更多厂商/日志/运行时/部署档案 真实版本/权限/数据集证据，标明PDB/RAC等范围 M6 历史欠项、接管切换、实机K8s、容量/长稳及发布门禁 各需求有功能、迁移、双语文档和不可混淆的验证记录 会话基础和源SPI设计可以并行分支推进，但先有规格与状态/协议合同；用户后续已授权开始实现；表中顺序不要求每个阶段只能串行。 8. 待细化决策（不重复询问已确定范围） - 集群控制后端首批支持产品、HA拓扑及Agent认证/注册方式；本地与共享档案如何升级。 - 会话空闲/绝对时限、浏览器关闭后记住登录、外部身份方式；这些是可配置策略，不影响先写接口和验收。 - PG首批确切版本、每任务database/schema范围及切主槽方案；Oracle首批版本、LogMiner/XStream路线、CDB/PDB/RAC/存储和驱动分发条件。 - 首批人工恢复的目标/日志档案、超大原事件保留位置和支持的受控源范围排除方式；未知边界始终不能假装已成功。 - Linux架构、真实K8s/CSI、厂商集群、硬件/网络/存储档案及压测资源；不编造统一TPS或恢复秒数。 9. SDD完成标准 需求ID关联设计、任务、API/UI、正向/拒绝/重复/中断测试、配置/状态升级、双语文档与同一候选包证据后才可标完成。构建通过不代表连接器通过；静态YAML不代表K8s实机通过；DOM/HTTP不代表视觉或可访问性通过。仅完成本轮整理不能把48项待办改为已实现。

RC-04 P0 / NEW Controlled capture/decode gap recovery Destination skipping cannot fix failures before complete events exist. Skip,compensation and full additional matrices remain separate. RC-06 P0 / DONE Failed-transaction before-image compensation The bounded SQL profile passed. Administrators review table scope and mutation counts across entries, restore the before-images and explicitly resume the original transaction. Typed entry and JSON import support administrator review of before/after values, exact identities, atomic batches and resumption of the original transaction. PostgreSQL passes real CDC and MySQL passes native checks. RC-10 tracks other destinations. Verification preserves SKIP and the original applied prefix without resuming. Other target protocols remain RC-10/LG-03/LG-04. title: 需求规格
text: Rivomesh SDD需求基线与未完成事项 RM-SDD-001 · v0.9 · 2026-11-17 · IMPLEMENTING 实施中：48项持续追踪，13项DONE、30项PARTIAL、5项NEW，余35项未闭环。RC-02、RC-05、RC-03、RC-06、RC-07 和 RC-08 限定档案已验收；自动接管、恢复作业和完整兼容矩阵继续追踪。 基线和决策 · 任务 · 验收矩阵 · English 多节点统一控制 ID 优先级/状态 需求 尚缺内容 --- --- --- --- CP-01 P0 / DONE 统一节点注册与状态 共享节点目录已通过PostgreSQL/MySQL双节点、kill/重开及控制库中断验收；任务权威/远端命令仍属CP-02/03。 CP-02 P0 / PARTIAL 全局任务、配置与操作权威状态 可选固定owner全局HTTP/界面、共享配置及历史已接入；旧任务升级导入、完整业务及规模验收仍未完成。 CP-03 P0 / PARTIAL 跨节点持久命令路由 公开持久命令、离线STOP、真实多目标校验/修复及原UNKNOWN升级恢复已验收；完整取消/故障/迁移与容量矩阵仍未完成。 CP-04 P0 / PARTIAL 故障接管、隔离与资源调度 已有Worker租约/epoch，缺少统一节点调度、远端生命周期和滚动升级协议。 CP-05 P0 / PARTIAL 共享权限、审计和密钥引用 共享账号/授权/链式审计及Worker环境过滤已实现；完整远端关联、最小密钥引用和进程/文件隔离仍缺。 CP-06 P1 / PARTIAL 全局日志、指标与诊断界面 全局任务观察、owner/未知状态、分页及维护结果已有；完整节点/目标过滤、远端日志和诊断检索仍缺。 Worker进程存活与日志接管就绪仍需更清晰区分。 CP-07 P0 / DONE 控制面HA及控制/数据面解耦 协议4分离档案已通过PG/MySQL控制库、管理全停/命令恢复、控制库中断、原Worker持续及非root验收；默认组合模式仍耦合，自动接管和其他存储/适配器档案另行追踪。 登录状态保持 ID 优先级/状态 需求 尚缺内容 --- --- --- --- SE-01 P0 / DONE 刷新后恢复登录态 已完成单控制器刷新/新页面恢复；跨控制器连续性仍属SE-04。 SE-02 P0 / DONE 会话期限、退出和撤销 已完成期限、退出、目录修订撤销及可配置记住浏览器；当前内存存储重启失效。 SE-03 P0 / DONE 安全会话传输和CSRF防护 已完成受保护Cookie、Origin/CSRF及TLS代理实测；生产TLS由代理终止。 SE-04 P0 / DONE 跨控制节点的会话连续性 已通过PostgreSQL/MySQL共享会话双节点、HTTPS、撤销、kill/重开及存储中断恢复验收；全局任务控制仍属CP-02/03。 SE-05 P1 / DONE CLI/API兼容及身份冲突规则 已完成Bearer兼容、不回退/身份冲突规则、权限重验、退出竞态及自身轮换。 人工恢复、跳过与补数据 ID 优先级/状态 需求 尚缺内容 --- --- --- --- RC-01 P0 / PARTIAL 按采集阶段区分故障 首次目标准备/快照及增量投递阶段已持久化并通过双入口真实故障/重启验收；完整源连接/读取/解码/DDL阶段及人工操作诊断仍待补。 RC-02 P0 / DONE 失败事务检查与原始证据留存 已验收MySQL8.4、固定原Agent/LOCAL日志、PG/MySQL控制库的ADMIN完整事务审阅及持久证据：位置/历史列/镜像、授权分页、重启及日志GC后可读。自动证据目录管理、其他档案、跨Agent迁移与执行语义另行追踪。 RC-03 P0 / DONE 目标应用阶段按完整事务跳过 档案通过。管理员跨入口审阅表范围及增删数量，按原事务前镜像恢复目标，随后显式恢复并重放。真实 CDC 验证 PostgreSQL 补偿，MySQL 通过原生合同。其他目标由 RC-10 追踪。 RC-07 P0 / DONE 界面手工补数据与修正 首批 SQL 档案通过。逐行录入和 JSON 导入支持管理员审阅前后值、精确行定位、原子批次和原事务恢复。PostgreSQL 通过真实 CDC，MySQL 通过原生检查。其他目标由 RC-10 跟踪。 RC-08 P0 / DONE 一致性缺口台账与真实水位 首批SQL档案已验收：持久缺口、审阅计划、跨入口审批/取消、全表重扫、原子凭据及安全覆盖/连续应用水位。核验不改写SKIP、不推进原应用前缀、不自动恢复；其他目标协议由RC-10/LG-03/LG-04继续追踪。 RC-09 P0 / PARTIAL 事件/位置SPI已有，真实源工厂与向导仍以MySQL为主。 SO-02 P1 / PARTIAL MySQL 5.7 完整支持档案 有5.7.44基础链路记录，未覆盖当前平台全部必要对象、恢复和运行时组合。 SO-03 P1 / PARTIAL MySQL 8.0 当前V3能力补验 有8.0.46历史V2/HA记录，不能直接作为当前V3全功能验收。 SO-04 P1 / NEW MySQL 8.2
