title: Task inventory
text: SDD task backlog RM-SDD-001 · 2026-11-17 Each task requires implementation,appropriate fault tests,bilingual docs and scoped evidence. Ten requirements are accepted;38 remain open. See thesingle baseline. Dependencies guide implementation order. Unified cluster control - [x] T-CP-01 · Global node registry and state · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: With two nodes,any console shows the same IDs,roles,versions/JDK/architecture,capacity,heartbeat age and ownership;stale/unreachable nodes are explicitly marked. Acceptance: AC-CP-01 - [ ] T-CP-02 · Global task/configuration authority · P0 · Depends on: CP-01 Deliver: A task created/edited through A appears at B with the same global revision;IDs are unique within a cluster;independent sources remain isolated and standalone mode remains usable. Acceptance: AC-CP-02 - [ ] T-CP-03 · Durable cross-node command routing · P0 · Depends on: CP-02 Deliver: Any entry controls tasks on B;typed commands cover create/check/lifecycle/retry/validation/repair and carry request ID,revision and owner generation;duplicate delivery is idempotent and acceptance is distinct from execution. Acceptance: AC-CP-03 - [ ] T-CP-04 · Failover,fencing and placement · P0 · Depends on: CP-03, JV-01, LG-05 Deliver: Power loss,partition and stale-node return never permit dual writers;unconfirmed stops remain unknown/fenced;placement respects JDK,adapter,storage reachability and quotas;drain/move preserves progress. Acceptance: AC-CP-04 - [ ] T-CP-05 · Shared authorization,audit and secret references · P0 · Depends on: CP-02 Deliver: Revocation at A is enforced at B;remote actions correlate by request/task/node/plan;secrets are not returned to UI and agents receive only authorized task references. Acceptance: AC-CP-05 - [ ] T-CP-06 · Cluster logs,metrics and diagnostics · P1 · Depends on: CP-01, CP-03, CP-05 Deliver: UI filters node/task/destination status,lag,backlog,logs and errors with observation timestamps and bounded redacted log access. Acceptance: AC-CP-06 - [x] T-CP-07 · Control-plane HA and worker independence · P0 · Depends on: CP-03, CP-05, SE-04 Deliver: Another entry survives controller failure;accepted commands recover;existing workers continue safely under documented policy;replica count/shared files alone are insufficient. Acceptance: AC-CP-07 Persistent login - [x] T-SE-01 · Session survives page reload · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Reload/reopening the site restores an unexpired session and permissions without reentering the token;expired sessions return to login without unintended actions. Acceptance: AC-SE-01 - [x] T-SE-02 · Session expiry,logout and revocation · P0 · Depends on: SE-01 Deliver: Idle/absolute expiry is configurable;logout,disable,rotation and revocation invalidate sessions as specified;tabs agree;remembering across browser closure is a separate configurable policy. Acceptance: AC-SE-02 - [x] T-SE-03 · Secure session transport and CSRF protection · P0 · Depends on: SE-01 Deliver: No readable long-lived browser credential;protected cookie/equivalent transport,HTTPS and HttpOnly/SameSite policy are verified;cookie-authenticated mutations enforce CSRF/Origin checks;session IDs never enter URLs/logs. Acceptance: AC-SE-03 - [x] T-SE-04 · Session continuity across controllers · P0 · Depends on: SE-02, SE-03, CP-01 Deliver: Login at A remains valid at B;controller restart/failover follows expiry/recovery policy;revocation propagates as specified without relying on sticky sessions to hide missing state. Acceptance: AC-SE-04 - [x] T-SE-05 · CLI/API compatibility and identity conflicts · P1 · Depends on: SE-03, CP-05 Deliver: Existing API tokens work;conflicting cookie/header identities follow explicit rules;restoration rechecks grants and late responses cannot revive logout;messages are bilingual. Acceptance: AC-SE-05 Manual recovery,skip and corrective data Implementation contract: failed transactions. Read-only inspection is not an execution credential;native receipts,gaps and format upgrades precede skip operations. - [ ] T-RC-01 · Phase-aware fault classification · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Distinguish source/read,decode,DDL/normalization,apply,ack and journal failures;UI offers only valid retry/compensation/skip/gap-recovery actions for that stage. Acceptance: AC-RC-01 - [x] T-RC-02 · Failed-transaction inspection and evidence retention · P0 · Depends on: RC-01, CP-05 Deliver: Show source/transaction identity,event range,affected objects/destinations,raw/normalized hashes,before/after-image availability and checkpoints;bounded raw access is authorized and evidence is retained before action. Acceptance: AC-RC-02 - [x] T-RC-03 · Skip a complete destination transaction · P0 · Depends on: RC-02, RC-05, RC-08 Deliver: For a known next failed transaction,ADMIN reviews destination scope/reason;cross-table events are not split;native SKIP receipt and safe progress commit locally and crash replay never skips another transaction. Acceptance: AC-RC-03 Accepted:bounded RC-03 profile;other products/full matrices stay open. - [ ] T-RC-04 · Controlled capture/decode gap recovery · P0 · Depends on: RC-01, RC-02, RC-08, SO-01 Deliver: Provide a separate verified transaction/source-range quarantine/exclusion plan affecting all relevant subscriptions with original logs retained;unprovable boundaries are refused with log recovery,valid source or rebaseline alternatives;never fabricate successful application. Acceptance: AC-RC-04 - [x] T-RC-05 · Uncertain commit and checkpoint reconciliation · P0 · Depends on: RC-02 Deliver: If commit leads ACK,verify content and recover acknowledgment instead of compensating or declaring an unapplied skip;identity,generation,epoch,error/config/hash/checkpoint mismatches refuse action. Acceptance: AC-RC-05 Accepted:protocol6 cross-entry ADMIN confirmation,native comparison,whole-task pause/fencing,atomic ACK/receipt,and retry under the bounded profile. Skip,compensation and gaps remain separate requirements. - [x] T-RC-06 · Failed-transaction before-image compensation · P0 · Depends on: RC-02, RC-05 Deliver: Reconstruct initial affected identity state across repeated keys,PK moves,insert/delete chains,keyless occurrences,JSON/generated values;modify only reviewed scope;commit compensation/receipt atomically without rewriting the source transaction/GTID. Acceptance: AC-RC-06 - [x] T-RC-07 · Guided manual corrective data entry · P0 · Depends on: RC-02, RC-05, RC-06 Deliver: UI offers typed insert/update/delete and import preview;precision,NULL,keys and occurrence IDs are validated;review before/after scope/counts;refuse drift and unsafe keyless bulk edits;no implicit source writes or dependency bypass. Acceptance: AC-RC-07 - [x] T-RC-08 · Consistency-gap ledger and honest watermarks · P0 · Depends on: RC-02 Deliver: Track skipped transactions/ranges,destinations,reason,actor,hashes and original evidence;separate applied progress,safe coverage and running-with-gaps;only verification evidence closes a gap and accepted loss is not equality. Acceptance: AC-RC-08 Accepted first SQL profile:verification,cross-entry commands,cancellation and honest progress;see design and verification. Other target protocols remain RC-10. - [ ] T-RC-09 · Durable distributed recovery jobs · P0 · Depends on: CP-03, RC-03, RC-06, RC-07 Deliver: Remote plans,approval,cancellation,receipts and evidence locations are traceable;controller/agent kill recovers the same request with idempotent commits/rollback;skip is not cutover approval. Acceptance: AC-RC-09 - [ ] T-RC-10 · Destination-specific recovery and retention · P1 · Depends on: RC-08, LG-03, LG-04 Deliver: Declare recovery capability per adapter;SQL uses local transactions,analytical/queue adapters verified receipts/gap notifications;other subscriptions are not silently skipped and unresolved evidence is retained with backpressure/alerts. Acceptance: AC-RC-10 Source compatibility - [ ] T-SO-01 · Source protocol and capability configuration · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Each task declares source type,identity,namespace and version;GTID,LSN and SCN are not interchangeable;UI/preflight follow real capabilities and reject unsupported profiles. Acceptance: AC-SO-01 - [ ] T-SO-02 · MySQL5.7 supported profile · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Pin patch/driver/log settings and verify snapshot-to-CDC,object capabilities,restart/promotion/log loss,supported DDL/recovery with explicit negative cases and independent evidence. Acceptance: AC-SO-02 - [ ] T-SO-03 · MySQL8.0 current V3 acceptance · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Reverify current-release multi-database fan-out,types/generated columns,transactions,ASYNC/MGR,recovery/manual operations with explicit patch/topology scope. Acceptance: AC-SO-03 - [ ] T-SO-04 · MySQL8.2 compatibility and acceptance · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Provide reproducible8.2 environment,version/auth/status/binlog handling and a complete first sync/recovery matrix;string matching/JDBC connectivity alone is insufficient. Acceptance: AC-SO-04 - [ ] T-SO-05 · MySQL8.4 expanded compatibility · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Reverify supported current-release profiles and declare tagged/untagged GTID,anonymous events,row images,compression/partial-JSON capabilities or refusal;version labels are not blanket feature acceptance. Acceptance: AC-SO-05 - [ ] T-SO-06 · PostgreSQL source adapter · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Implement consistent snapshot/LSN handoff,slots/publications,ordering/replay,replica identity,types/DDL and recovery;verify WAL/slot loss/promotion per version;expose GUI/CLI/docs. Acceptance: AC-SO-06 - [ ] T-SO-07 · Oracle source adapter · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Specify capture route,versions,privileges and driver distribution conditions;implement SCN snapshot,commit/rollback,redo/archive,DB identity/incarnation,checkpoint/replay;verify LOB,charset,PDB/RAC scope explicitly. Acceptance: AC-SO-07 Java runtime compatibility - [ ] T-JV-01 · Java8/11/17/21/25 runnable releases · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: The candidate controller/agent/worker actually starts on all five JDKs with real JVM version,artifact hash,architecture and dependencies recorded;Java8 class/driver requirements are verified. Acceptance: AC-JV-01 - [ ] T-JV-02 · Cross-JDK source/sink/recovery matrix · P1 · Depends on: JV-01, SO-02, SO-03, SO-04, SO-05, SO-06, SO-07 Deliver: Each approved source profile crosses five JDKs for snapshot,CDC,restart and equality;record separate adapter/SDK/TLS/object/cluster/recovery gates and never label unrun combinations passed. Acceptance: AC-JV-02 - [ ] T-JV-03 · Driver isolation,dependencies and TLS compatibility · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Verify service loading,reflection/modules,auth/TLS/certificates,reconnect,precision and vendor minimum JDK;incompatible combinations are explicitly refused,not inferred from compilation. Acceptance: AC-JV-03 - [ ] T-JV-04 · Multi-JDK deployment and mixed-version upgrades · P1 · Depends on: CP-04, JV-02, JV-03, LG-08 Deliver: Provide five-JDK deployment profiles/placement constraints and verify command,event,state and rolling-upgrade compatibility;unsupported downgrade is refused with recovery guidance. Acceptance: AC-JV-04 Complete documentation - [ ] T-DO-01 · Bilingual traceable SDD baseline · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Each requirement has stable ID,status,gap,dependencies,priority,acceptance and task;ZH/EN IDs match and changes preserve evidence scope. Acceptance: AC-DO-01 - [ ] T-DO-02 · Deployment and cluster operations docs · P1 · Depends on: CP-07, SE-04, JV-04, LG-05, LG-06 Deliver: Provide runnable standalone/cluster examples for four deployment paths with stores,secrets/TLS,enrollment/drain,backup/restore/upgrades and local-storage boundaries;live K8s requires separate evidence. Acceptance: AC-DO-02 - [ ] T-DO-03 · Recovery scenarios and FAQ · P1 · Depends on: RC-09, RC-10, SE-05 Deliver: Each scenario states symptoms,cause,UI/API steps,positions,gaps,idempotency/undo limits across promotion,log loss,SQL/ack,node/storage,session and manual recovery. Acceptance: AC-DO-03 - [ ] T-DO-04 · Configuration/API/compatibility and upgrade docs · P1 · Depends on: SO-01, JV-02, CP-03 Deliver: Document configuration,grants,codes,request/command/plan versions,source coordinates,consistency and source/sink/JDK profiles with examples/evidence;schema changes update both languages. Acceptance: AC-DO-04 - [ ] T-DO-05 · Documentation and evidence release gates · P1 · Depends on: DO-01, DO-02, DO-03, DO-04, LG-09 Deliver: Check links,examples,APIs and bilingual coverage;completion links candidate hash/native evidence;DOM is not visual,static YAML is not live deployment,and builds are not adapter acceptance. Acceptance: AC-DO-05 Preserved earlier scope - [ ] T-LG-01 · Domestic transactional database matrix · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Record sync/recovery/manual capabilities by product,version,mode,distribution/index/driver/JDK;commercial distributed hardware is separately accepted,not inferred from PG protocol connectivity. Acceptance: AC-LG-01 - [ ] T-LG-02 · Nonempty adoption,constraints,cutover/failback · P1 · Depends on: RC-09, SO-01 Deliver: Implement adoption/difference planning,constraint restoration,final source cut,write handoff and failback conditions;dual-write/bidirectional conflict policy is separately specified. Acceptance: AC-LG-02 - [ ] T-LG-03 · ClickHouse/Doris/Hive production profiles · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Verify visibility,dedup/batch receipts,restart,old-backup,cluster and gaps per product without claiming ordinary SQL cross-table atomicity. Acceptance: AC-LG-03 - [ ] T-LG-04 · Queue cluster and recovery profiles · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Each queue verifies lost confirmations,election,durable receipts,resource loss,consumer dedup/backlog and skip-gap protocol with honest delivery/consumption boundaries. Acceptance: AC-LG-04 - [ ] T-LG-05 · Optional storage and cross-node reachability · P0 · Depends on: CP-02 Deliver: Local mode documents durable volume/pinning/disk-loss limits;external/shared modes are accepted per capability;move verifies logs,evidence,reports and secrets,not just cursors;independent journal infrastructure is not mandatory for every deployment. Acceptance: AC-LG-05 - [ ] T-LG-06 · Live K8s/CSI and node-fault acceptance · P1 · Depends on: CP-04, CP-07, LG-05 Deliver: Verify upgrade/scale,pod/node failure,RWO/CSI remount,secret rotation and stale-owner fencing on a real cluster with published configuration/evidence. Acceptance: AC-LG-06 - [ ] T-LG-07 · Large catalogs,transactions and hardware standards · P1 · Depends on: JV-02, LG-05 Deliver: Bound memory/disk for large transactions/catalogs/slow sinks and publish multi-run hardware/workload results without linear extrapolation or count-only correctness. Acceptance: AC-LG-07 - [ ] T-LG-08 · Historical DDL,types,indexes and state migration · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Preserve source schema history,reviewed plans and identity keys;create first-release state directly without prerelease-candidate compatibility;verify current-state backup/restore,corruption refusal and product-specific limits. Acceptance: AC-LG-08 - [ ] T-LG-09 · Report retention and real-browser acceptance · P1 · Depends on: CP-06, SE-05, RC-09 Deliver: Provide authorized report/receipt search,retention and active-file protection;real browsers verify cluster/session/confirmation/recovery/pagination and accessibility. Acceptance: AC-LG-09 - [ ] T-LG-10 · External identity,immutable audit and Apache preparation · P2 · Depends on: CP-05, SE-05 Deliver: Verify external identity/revocation,external audit and distribution conditions;complete license/NOTICE/SBOM/contribution docs without claiming Apache affiliation or trademark rights. Acceptance: AC-LG-10 Recent deliverables (not additional parent requirements) Parent Reviewable delivery State --- --- --- RC-08 Immutable verification scope and plan hash DONE RC-08 Cross-entry ADMIN approval,durable commands and cancellation DONE RC-08 Fresh full affected-table scans against sealed source roots DONE RC-08 Atomic receipts/gap links and idempotent recovery DONE RC-08 Console,authorization,late-response handling and bilingual FAQ DONE RC-08 Distinct safe coverage,contiguous application and broker semantics DONE RC-06 Before-image reconstruction, atomic target writes, cross-entry approval, and console Java, DOM, both native target profiles and real CDC passed RC-07 Typed entry, JSON import, before/after approval and atomic batches Bounded SQL profile passed RC-09 Distributed recovery jobs and commit-boundary tests NEXT

title: 任务清单
text: SDD任务清单 RM-SDD-001 · 2026-11-17 每项任务完成必须包括设计/实现、正反向与中断恢复测试、双语文档和候选包证据。已验收节点目录、5项会话任务及CP-07限定分离档案，RC-02事务审阅及RC-05已提交事务确认限定档案已验收，RC-03完整事务跳过限定档案已验收，余35项保持未完成；见会话证据和执行生命周期证据。依赖是实施顺序，不表示必须等待所有厂商档案才能开发公共框架。 多节点统一控制 - [x] T-CP-01 · 统一节点注册与状态 · P0 · 依赖：无 交付：部署两个节点后，任一管理入口均显示相同节点ID、角色、版本/JDK/架构、容量、心跳时间和任务归属；失联显示过期/未知，不能伪装成健康。 验收：AC-CP-01 - [ ] T-CP-02 · 全局任务、配置与操作权威状态 · P0 · 依赖：CP-01 交付：同一集群中从A创建/修改任务后B读到同一全局修订；全局taskId唯一，独立任务与源配置仍隔离；单机模式保留可运行配置。 验收：AC-CP-02 - [ ] T-CP-03 · 跨节点持久命令路由 · P0 · 依赖：CP-02 交付：任一入口可控制B的任务：创建、检查、启停、暂停/恢复、重试、校验/修复；命令含全局请求ID/修订/owner代次，重复投递只生效一次，202仅表示接受，返回已执行/拒绝/未知结果。 验收：AC-CP-03 - [ ] T-CP-04 · 故障接管、隔离与资源调度 · P0 · 依赖：CP-03, JV-01, LG-05 交付：节点断电/网络分区/旧节点恢复时同一任务无双写；未确认停机可标记未知并隔离；按JDK、连接器、存储可达性和配额调度；排空迁移保留断点。 验收：AC-CP-04 - title: SDD 文档索引
text: Rivomesh Spec-Driven Development 以需求规格驱动设计、任务、实现与验收。先登记规格与差距，代码和文档变更再关联对应需求ID，最后用候选发布包的真实证据关闭条目。本目录使用可评审的Markdown/JSON，不依赖安装特定SDD工具。 Use specifications to drive design,tasks,implementation and acceptance. Record requirements/gaps first,link subsequent code/docs to requirement IDs,then close them with candidate-release evidence. Markdown/JSON keep this process tool-independent. 基线 / Baseline 入口 / Entry 状态 / State --- --- --- RM-SDD-001 · 多节点、会话、恢复、源/JDK兼容和文档 中文规格 / English v0.3实施中：节点目录+4项会话已验收，43项未完成 / registry+4session requirements accepted,43open 每包包括spec、plan、tasks、acceptance及机器可读requirements.json。NEW/PARTIAL/DONE是实现状态，P0/P1/P2是建议优先级；不能用“规划中”冒充“支持”。 Each package contains spec,plan,tasks,acceptance and requirements.json. NEW/PARTIAL/DONE are implementation states;P0/P1/P2 are proposed priorities. Planned capabilities are never presented as supported.

title: 验证记录汇总
text: 验证范围 当前实施状态 · 首版验证基线 · SDD验收 本页统一指向当前基线，不再重复记录逐次构建、失败尝试和旧发布候选。不同版本/产品/JDK的记录不能合并为全矩阵通过。

title: 首版验证基线 / Verification baseline
text: 首版验证基线 / First-release verification baseline 仅保留当前基线索引；开发过程中的重复源码/脚本副本、失败尝试和逐次快照已从工作树移除。Git提交历史保留追溯。操作文档见中文实施状态和English。 The compact baseline preserves the exact bounded acceptance provenance. Earlier results are not relabelled as fresh validation of cleanup changes. Current validation status is tracked in baseline.json. No production compatibility or full product matrix is implied.
